AI.motivation: 需要为创意写作质量建立一个可量化、可分析的理论框架
AI.method: 利用香农互信息 $I(X;Y) = H(X) - H(X|Y)$ 作为分析工具，结合案例研究和轻量级LLM对数概率计算
AI.result: 证明了"校准"意味着条件熵趋近于零，"惊喜"意味着熵增，互信息是其联合精确度量
AI.conclusion: 论文为"创意质量对齐"(CQA)奠定了理论基础，并提出可操作的专业评估基准

title: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Discounting for Mitigating Reward Hacking
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) systems typically optimize scalar reward functions that assume precise and reliable evaluation of outcomes. However, real-world objectives--especially those derived from human preferences--are often uncertain, context-dependent, and internally inconsistent. This mismatch can lead to alignment failures such as reward hacking, over-optimization, and overconfident behavior.
  We introduce a dual-source uncertainty-aware reward framework that explicitly models both epistemic uncertainty in value estimation and uncertainty in human preferences. Model uncertainty is captured via ensemble disagreement over value predictions, while preference uncertainty is derived from variability in reward annotations. We combine these signals through a confidence-adjusted Reliability Filter that adaptively modulates action selection, encouraging a balance between exploitation and caution.
  Empirical results across multiple discrete grid configurations (6x6, 8x8, 10x10) and high-dimensional continuous control environments (Hopper-v4, Walker2d-v4) demonstrate that our approach yields more stable training dynamics and reduces exploitative behaviors under reward ambiguity, achieving a 93.7% reduction in reward-hacking behavior as measured by trap visitation frequency. We demonstrate statistical significance of these improvements and robustness under up to 30% supervisory noise, albeit with a trade-off in peak observed reward compared to unconstrained baselines.
  By treating uncertainty as a first-class component of the reward signal, this work offers a principled approach toward more reliable and aligned reinforcement learning systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种双源不确定性感知奖励框架，通过集成方法建模认知不确定性、通过标注变异性建模偏好不确定性，结合可靠性滤波器平衡探索与谨慎，在保持训练稳定性和抑制奖励黑客（减少93.7%）的同时，需接受峰值性能下降的代价。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的目标（尤其是源自人类偏好的目标）往往不确定、依赖上下文且内部不一致，而传统RL系统优化的标量奖励函数假定结果评估精确可靠。这种不匹配导致对齐失败，如奖励黑客、过度优化和过度自信行为。
AI.method: 提出双源不确定性感知奖励框架，同时建模认知不确定性和偏好不确定性。认知不确定性通过价值预测的集成分歧捕获，偏好不确定性从奖励标注的变异性中提取。通过置信度调整的可靠性滤波器（Reliability Filter）自适应调节动作选择，实现 exploitation 与 caution 的平衡。
AI.result: 在多种离散网格环境（6x6, 8x8, 10x10）和高维连续控制环境（Hopper-v4, Walker2d-v4）中验证了该方法的有效性。奖励黑客行为减少93.7%（以陷阱访问频率衡量），训练动态更稳定，在高达30%监督噪声下具有鲁棒性。但与无约束基线相比，峰值奖励存在一定折衷。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明将不确定性作为奖励信号的一阶组成部分，能够构建更可靠、更对齐的强化学习系统。该框架在保持训练稳定性的同时，有效抑制了奖励黑客行为，但需在性能与安全性之间进行权衡。

title: ClassEval-Pro: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Class-Level Code Generation
comment: Accepted to AIware 2026. Code and data available at https://github.com/ian-Kappa/ClassEval-Pro
summary: LLMs have achieved strong results on both function-level code synthesis and repository-level code modification, yet a capability that falls between these two extremes -- compositional code creation, i.e., building a complete, internally structured class from a specification -- remains underserved. Current evaluations are either confined to isolated functions or rely on manually curated class-level tasks that are expensive to scale and increasingly susceptible to data contamination. We introduce ClassEval-Pro, a benchmark of 300 class-level tasks spanning 11 domains, constructed through an automated three-stage pipeline that combines complexity enhancement, cross-domain class composition, and integration of real-world GitHub code contributed after January 2025. Every task is validated by an LLM Judge Ensemble and must pass test suites with over 90% line coverage. We evaluate five frontier LLMs under five generation strategies. The best model achieves only 45.6% class-level Pass@1, with a 17.7-point gap between the strongest and weakest models, confirming the benchmark's discriminative power. Strategy choice strongly interacts with model capability: structured approaches such as bottom-up improve weaker models by up to 9.4 percentage points, while compositional generation collapses to as low as 1.3%. Error analysis over 500 manually annotated failures reveals that logic errors (56.2%) and dependency errors (38.0%) dominate, identifying cross-method coordination as the core bottleneck.

AI.tldr: ClassEval-Pro是一个包含300个类级任务的基准测试，用于评估LLM的组合式代码创建能力。该基准通过自动化三阶段流程构建，涵盖11个领域，经过严格验证（LLM Judge Ensemble + >90%行覆盖率的测试套件）。最佳模型Pass@1仅为45.6%，表明类级代码生成仍是重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前代码生成评估存在两个极端：要么局限于独立函数级合成，要么依赖昂贵且易受数据污染影响的手动策划类级任务。介于两者之间的组合式代码创建（从规格说明构建完整、结构化的类）能力尚未得到充分评估。
AI.method: 采用自动化三阶段流水线构建基准：(1)复杂度增强，(2)跨领域类组合，(3)整合2025年1月之后的真实GitHub代码。每个任务通过LLM Judge Ensemble验证，并需通过覆盖率超过90%的测试套件。评估了5个前沿LLM在5种生成策略下的表现。
AI.result: 最强模型类级Pass@1仅为45.6%；最强与最弱模型间存在17.7个百分点差距，证明基准具有区分力。策略选择与模型能力高度相关：结构化方法（如自底向上）可使弱模型提升最多9.4个百分点，而组合式生成性能低至1.3%。
AI.conclusion: 对500个手动标注失败案例的错误分析表明：逻辑错误（56.2%）和依赖错误（38.0%）是主要失败原因，揭示跨方法协调是类级代码生成的核心瓶颈。

title: CoQuant: Joint Weight-Activation Subspace Projection for Mixed-Precision LLMs
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become an important technique for reducing the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs). While recent mixed-precision methods improve ultra-low bit quantization by preserving critical subspaces in high precision, they typically construct these subspaces relying solely on activation statistics. This ignores the fundamental nature of linear operations, where the output perturbation is jointly driven by both activation and weight quantization noise. In this paper, we propose CoQuant, a joint weight-activation subspace projection method. By theoretically modeling the expected output error, CoQuant formulates a closed-form weighted PCA solution that balances activation and weight covariances to select the optimal high-precision subspace. Extensive experiments on Llama-3.2 and Qwen2.5 models show that CoQuant consistently outperforms strong PTQ baselines in both WikiText perplexity and zero-shot common-sense reasoning accuracy. These results demonstrate that joint weight-activation subspace modeling provides a principled and effective direction for low-bit LLM quantization. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zachary5895/CoQuant.

AI.tldr: CoQuant是一种联合权重-激活子空间投影方法，通过理论建模输出误差推导加权PCA解决方案，同时考虑激活和权重量化噪声的影响，在多个LLM家族上验证了其在低比特量化任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法仅依赖激活统计信息构造关键子空间，忽略了线性运算中输出扰动由激活和权重量化噪声共同驱动的本质特性。
AI.method: CoQuant通过理论建模期望输出误差，推导出一个闭合形式的加权PCA解决方案，平衡激活和权重的协方差矩阵来选择最优的高精度子空间。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2和Qwen2.5模型上，CoQuant在WikiText困惑度和零样本常识推理准确率两项指标上均超越强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CoQuant通过联合建模权重和激活的协方差，提出了一种原则性且有效的低比特LLM量化方向，在Llama-3.2和Qwen2.5模型上均优于强基线方法。

title: Benchmarking PyCaret AutoML Against BiLSTM for Fine-Grained Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study on 20-Class Emotion Detection
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. This paper compares machine learning and deep learning methods for 20-class emotion classification on an English text dataset of 79,595 samples
summary: Fine-grained emotion classification, which identifies specific emotional states such as happiness, anger, sadness, and fear, remains a challenging task in natural language processing. This study benchmarks classical machine learning and deep learning approaches for 20-class emotion classification using the 20-Emotion Text Classification Dataset containing 79,595 English sentences. On the machine learning side, Logistic Regression, Multinomial Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine are evaluated using TF-IDF features. On the deep learning side, Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory, Gated Recurrent Unit, and a lightweight Transformer implemented in PyTorch are compared. The results show that BiLSTM achieves the best overall performance with 89% accuracy and a weighted F1-score of 0.89, slightly outperforming the best machine learning model, SVM, which reaches 88.11% accuracy. The findings indicate that while traditional machine learning models remain competitive and computationally efficient, sequence-based deep learning models better capture contextual emotional cues in text.

AI.tldr: 本文在 20-Emotion 数据集（79,595 条英文句子、20 类情绪）上对 3 个经典机器学习模型（LR、多项式朴素贝叶斯、LinearSVC，基于 TF-IDF）与 3 个深度学习模型（BiLSTM、双向 GRU、轻量 Transformer，PyTorch 实现）进行同条件基准对比。结果：BiLSTM 最优（准确率 89%、加权 F1 0.89），GRU 88%、Transformer 87%，最佳 ML 模型 SVM 达 88.11%（加权 F1 0.8808），BiLSTM 仅领先约 0.9 个百分点；ML 模型训练几乎瞬时，DL 模型需 5m53s~11m09s（Tesla T4）。结论：序列深度模型在绝对精度上略优，但传统 ML 在算力受限时仍具强竞争力。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情绪分类（20 类情绪，区别于正/负二分类）任务复杂度高，在心理健康监测、客服反馈分析、社交媒体情感追踪等场景有重要应用价值。虽然"传统机器学习（手工特征 + TF-IDF）"与"深度学习（自动学习表示）"两条技术路线各有大量成果，但在大类别数（20 类）细粒度情绪分类上、在相同数据与相同实验条件下的直接系统对比仍较为缺乏。同时 PyCaret 等 AutoML 框架降低了流水线搭建与模型对比的门槛，使统一基准比较更易实现。因此本文目标是对两条范式做系统基准评测，并分析性能、训练时间与计算复杂度之间的权衡。
AI.method: 数据集：20-Emotion Text Classification Dataset，79,595 条英文句子，20 个情绪标签（happiness、sadness、anger、fear、love、surprise、disgust、trust、anticipation、anxiety、boredom、confusion、curiosity、excitement、guilt、loneliness、nostalgia、pride、relief、shame），平均句长约 12 token。预处理：小写化、去标点与特殊字符、分词、停用词去除（用于 ML）、按 80/10/10 分层划分训练/验证/测试集。特征：ML 用 TF-IDF（词表上限 50,000）；DL 用词嵌入层（维度 128，词表 30,000，最大序列长度 128）。ML 侧（以 AutoML 基准方式比较）：逻辑回归（L-BFGS 求解器、L2 正则，基线）、多项式朴素贝叶斯（Laplace 平滑 α=1.0）、LinearSVC（平方合页损失、L2 正则）。DL 侧统一配置：2 层、隐藏维度 256（Transformer 为 128）、Dropout 0.3、Adam 学习率 0.001、Batch size 64、训练 10 epoch、参数量均低于 1000 万；Transformer 为 4 注意力头、2 层编码器、前馈维度 512 并加位置编码；全部在 PyTorch 实现。实验环境为 Google Colab + NVIDIA Tesla T4，ML 用 scikit-learn 在 CPU 训练。评估指标：准确率、Macro F1、加权 F1、训练（墙钟）时间。最佳 ML 与 DL 模型部署为 Hugging Face Spaces 交互式 Web 应用。
AI.result: BiLSTM 综合最优：准确率 89%、加权 F1 0.89，优于最佳 ML 模型 SVM（88.11%，加权 F1 0.8808）约 0.9 个百分点；GRU 88%（F1 0.88），轻量 Transformer 87%（F1 0.86）略逊；ML 内部 SVM > LR（86.56%）> Naive Bayes（83.81%）。解释方面：双向结构能同时利用前后文，更利于捕捉依赖词序与句式的细微情绪线索；朴素贝叶斯落后源于其特征独立假设在情绪化文本中被违背；Transformer 表现不佳可能因数据规模（数万样本）不足以在无预训练的情况下充分发挥注意力表示优势。训练效率差异显著：ML 几乎瞬时收敛，BiLSTM 约 5m53s、GRU 约 7m09s、Transformer 约 11m09s（均为 GPU）。结论是性能差距很小，说明强特征工程下的 TF-IDF + SVM 极具竞争力，在无 GPU 场景是更优权衡。
AI.conclusion: BiLSTM 在准确率、加权 F1、训练稳定性与计算效率之间取得最佳平衡，是本文六模型中的最佳选择；深度学习在绝对精度与上下文表示质量上优于机器学习，但优势幅度有限（约 0.9 个百分点）；SVM 以极低算力成本提供高度 competitive 的替代方案，适合计算资源受限的部署场景；Transformer 在该数据集上仍需进一步调优，其优势更可能在更大规模数据或预训练表示下体现。作者指出后续工作可引入 BERT、RoBERTa 等预训练语言模型与数据增强策略，以改善欠采样情绪类别的表现。需注意的细节问题：标题强调的“PyCaret AutoML”与正文实际做法（scikit-learn 手写三模型对比）存在一定名实不符，正文中 PyCaret 仅在相关工作中作为 AutoML 框架背景提及；此外 ML 模型未报告 Macro F1 与训练时间，F1 列的口径（BiLSTM 为加权 F1，SVM 标注 0.8808）需进一步核验，论文亦未给出显著性检验与多次运行的方差，Transformer 未使用预训练模型这一对比设定也削弱了对“深度学习更优”这一结论的强度。

title: Unifying Runtime Monitoring Approaches for Safety-Critical Machine Learning: Application to Vision-Based Landing
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, submitted to ICPR 2026
summary: Runtime monitoring is essential to ensure the safety of ML applications in safety-critical domains. However, current research is fragmented, with independent methods emerging from different communities. In this paper, we propose a unified framework categorising runtime monitoring approaches into three distinct types: Operational Design Domain (ODD) monitoring, which ensures compliance with expected operating conditions; Out-of-Distribution (OOD) monitoring, which rejects inputs that deviate from the training data; and Out-of-Model-Scope (OMS) monitoring, which detects anomalous model behaviour based its internal states or outputs. We demonstrate the benefits of this categorization with a dedicated experiment on an aeronautical safety-critical application: runway detection during landing. This framework facilitates design of monitoring activities, with complementary categories of monitors, and enables evaluation and comparison of different monitors using common, safety-oriented metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一的三类运行时监控框架（ODD、OOD、OMS），解决当前研究分散问题，并在航空跑道检测场景中验证了该框架的有效性
AI.motivation: 运行时监控对于安全关键领域的ML应用至关重要，但当前研究分散，不同社区提出了独立方法，缺乏统一分类
AI.method: 提出统一框架，将运行时监控方法分为三类：(1) ODD监控确保符合预期操作条件；(2) OOD监控拒绝偏离训练数据的输入；(3) OMS监控基于内部状态或输出检测异常模型行为
AI.result: 在航空安全关键应用（着陆过程中的跑道检测）上进行专门实验验证
AI.conclusion: 该框架促进监控活动设计，支持互补监控器组合，并可使用通用安全导向指标评估和比较不同监控器

title: Classification of Public Opinion on the Free Nutritional Meal Program on YouTube Media Using the LSTM Method
comment: 10 pages 3 figures 3 tables Conference submission on YouTube sentiment classification using LSTM for the Free Nutritious Meal Program
summary: Public opinion towards the Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) on YouTube social media reflects diverse community responses. This study applies the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) method to classify sentiments from 7,733 YouTube comments. The results show that the LSTM model achieves 89% accuracy, with strong performance on negative sentiment (F1-score 0.94) but weaker performance on positive sentiment (F1-score 0.55) due to class imbalance, as negative data account for 87.7% of the dataset. These findings confirm the effectiveness of LSTM for sentiment analysis of Indonesian text while highlighting the challenge of imbalanced data. This research contributes to social media-based public policy evaluation

AI.tldr: 本文以印尼"免费营养餐计划"(MBG)为对象，爬取两个 YouTube 频道共 7,733 条评论，采用 LSTM 深度学习模型进行情感二分类（正/负）。测试集准确率达 89%，负向类 F1=0.94 表现优秀，正向类 F1=0.55 明显偏弱，根本原因是数据极端不平衡（负向 87.7%、正向仅 12.3%）。研究验证了 LSTM 在印尼语文本情感分析中的有效性，同时暴露了类别不平衡对少数类识别的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 公共政策的公众态度传统上依赖问卷调查，周期长、成本高、样本受限。社交媒体（尤其是 YouTube 评论）具备实时、规模大、直接反映公众意见的特点，可作为数据驱动决策的舆论监测工具。印尼 MBG 免费营养餐计划作为受到广泛关注的民生政策，在 YouTube 上积累了大量包含支持、批评与质疑的评论，但缺乏系统化的情感量化分析工具。同时，Naive Bayes、逻辑回归、SVM 等传统方法依赖词袋/TF-IDF 特征，无法有效捕捉语序与上下文（如"tidak bagus"这类否定结构），而 LSTM 通过记忆单元与门控机制可建模长距离依赖，更适合情感分类任务，因此适合该场景。
AI.method: 采用定量研究流程：数据采集→文本预处理→特征表示→建模→评估。数据采集：对两个讨论 MBG 的 YouTube 频道进行评论抓取，共 7,733 条（频道1：3,342，频道2：4,391）。预处理包含大小写折叠、去 URL/@提及/#标签/数字/标点、非标准词与俚语归一化、分词、NLTK 停用词过滤、Sastrawi 词干还原。特征表示：用 Tokenizer 将词映射为整数索引（词表 16,378），并做 padding 使序列等长。模型：以 LSTM 为主模型，网络结构为 Embedding(128 维，padding_idx=0) → LSTM(隐藏维 128，dropout 0.3) → Dropout(0.5) → 全连接层(2 个神经元) → Softmax 输出；共 2,228,738 个参数，batch size 16，Adam 优化器，学习率 0.0005，训练 20 epoch，损失函数为交叉熵。基线对比：SVM、逻辑回归、Naive Bayes。评估：在 963 条测试样本上使用混淆矩阵与分类报告，计算准确率、精确率、召回率、F1。
AI.result: 标签分布高度不平衡：负向 5,629 条（87.7%），正向 790 条（12.3%）。训练过程收敛良好：训练准确率 98.26%，验证准确率 88.99%，损失由 0.68 降至 0.1225（20 epoch）。测试集（963 条）整体准确率 89%：负向类精确率 0.94、召回率 0.93、F1 0.94（支持度 845）；正向类精确率 0.54、召回率 0.57、F1 0.55（支持度 118）；宏平均 F1 0.74，加权平均 F1 0.89。混淆矩阵显示 TN=787、TP=67、FN=51、FP=58——假阴性数量偏高，表明模型预测偏向负向类别，对少数类（正向）识别能力不足。
AI.conclusion: LSTM 能在印尼语文本上有效实现 YouTube 评论情感分类，89% 的准确率与负向类 0.94 的 F1 证明其对批判性公众意见的捕捉能力，可为 MBG 等公共政策的社会化评估提供可操作的分析范式。核心结论是数据平衡是深度学习分类任务的关键制约因素：类别不平衡导致模型系统性偏向多数类，使正向意见被大量误判为负向，直接影响政策制定者对"支持度"或"满意度"的判断，可能低估公众中的积极反馈。后续工作建议：采用 SMOTE 或类别加权等平衡技术、扩充正向标注样本、引入 Bi-LSTM、CNN-LSTM 等更强架构以改善少数类性能，并进一步与基线方法做严格对比验证 LSTM 的增量价值。

title: STLGT: A Scalable Trace-Based Linear Graph Transformer for Tail Latency Prediction in Microservices
summary: Accurate end-to-end tail-latency forecasting is critical for proactive SLO management in microservice systems. However, modeling long-range dependency propagation and non-stationary, bursty workloads while maintaining inference efficiency at scale remains challenging. We present STLGT (Scalable Trace-based Linear Graph Transformer), a per-API predictor that encodes traces as span graphs for multi-step p95 tail-latency forecasting. STLGT uses a structure-aware linear graph Transformer to propagate cross-service dependencies with inference time linear in span graph size, and a decoupled temporal module to capture workload dynamics. Across a personalized education microservice application, DeathStarBench, and Alibaba traces, STLGT improves forecasting accuracy over PERT-GNN by 8.5% MAPE on average and achieves up to 12x faster CPU inference at N=32, matching the maximum span graph size after preprocessing the Alibaba traces. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of each component, especially under bursty traffic.

AI.tldr: STLGT是一种可扩展的基于轨迹的线性图Transformer，通过结构感知线性图Transformer和解耦时间模块实现多步p95尾延迟预测，在保持线性推理复杂度的同时显著优于现有方法，尤其擅长处理突发流量场景。
AI.motivation: 尾延迟预测对于微服务系统的主动SLO管理至关重要。然而，现有方法面临三个核心挑战：1）难以建模长距离依赖传播；2）难以处理非平稳的突发工作负载；3）在规模化场景下难以保持推理效率。这些挑战阻碍了有效的主动性能管理。
AI.method: STLGT采用双模块架构：1）结构感知线性图Transformer编码器，将轨迹编码为跨度图以传播跨服务依赖关系，推理时间与跨度图大小呈线性关系；2）解耦的时间模块用于捕捉非平稳的突发工作负载动态。该方法以per-API预测器形式实现，适用于大规模微服务系统的实时预测场景。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集（个性化教育微服务应用、DeathStarBench和阿里云轨迹）上的评估表明：STLGT相比PERT-GNN平均提升预测精度8.5% MAPE；在N=32（阿里轨迹预处理后的最大跨度图规模）下实现12倍CPU推理加速；消融实验验证了各组件的有效性，尤其在突发流量场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: STLGT是一个有效的多步p95尾延迟预测器，能够在大规模场景下保持高效推理，同时捕捉服务间的依赖关系和工作负载动态变化。

title: A Systematic Comparison of Prompting and Multi-Agent Methods for LLM-based Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection identifies the attitude of a text author toward a given target. Recent studies have explored various LLM-based strategies for this task, from zero-shot prompting to multi-agent debate. However, existing works differ in data splits, base models, and evaluation protocols, making fair comparison difficult. We conduct a systematic comparison that evaluates five methods across two categories -- prompt-based inference (Direct Prompting, Auto-CoT, StSQA) and agent-based debate (COLA, MPRF) -- on four datasets with 14 subtasks, using 15 LLMs from six model families with parameter sizes from 7B to 72B+. Our experiments yield several findings. First, on all models with complete results, the best prompt-based method outperforms the best agent-based method, while agent methods require 7 to 12 times more API calls per sample. Second, model scale has a larger impact on performance than method choice, with gains plateauing around 32B. Third, reasoning-enhanced models (DeepSeek-R1) do not consistently outperform general models of the same size on this task.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM立场检测方法进行系统比较，评估了5种方法（提示推理类和智能体辩论类），覆盖15个LLM和4个数据集14个子任务。研究表明：模型规模的影响大于方法选择，提示方法优于辩论方法但计算成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM立场检测研究存在数据划分、基座模型和评估协议不一致的问题，导致方法间难以公平比较。
AI.method: 采用控制变量法系统评估两类方法：1) 提示推理类（Direct Prompting、Auto-CoT、StSQA）；2) 智能体辩论类（COLA、MPRF）。实验覆盖6个模型家族、参数规模7B-72B+的15个LLM，在4个数据集14个子任务上进行评测。
AI.result: 1. 所有模型上，最佳提示方法性能优于最佳辩论方法，但辩论方法需7-12倍API调用量；2. 模型规模对性能影响大于方法选择，增益在约32B参数时趋于饱和；3. 推理增强模型（DeepSeek-R1）并不一致优于同规模通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 对于立场检测任务，更大规模的基础模型比复杂方法设计更具价值；推理增强模型在此任务上未展现明显优势。

title: Layer-wise Lipschitz-Product Control for Deep Kolmogorov--Arnold Network Representations of Compositionally Structured Functions
comment: 15 pages, theoretical note on layer-wise Lipschitz control for deep KANs
summary: We prove that any continuous function f from [0,1]^n to R representable by a finite computation tree with N internal nodes and compositional sparsity s = O(1) admits a deep Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) representation. Each internal node is realised by a primitive KAN block with controlled block depth and Lipschitz product. The layer-wise Lipschitz product satisfies the primary domain-sensitive bound independent of the input dimension n. It simplifies to P(KAN_f) <= max(C*,1)^L_f with L_f <= c_max * N. For the standard operations {+,-,x,sin,cos} with x nodes on [0,1]-bounded inputs we obtain P(KAN) <= 1. Layer widths satisfy n_l <= n + 2 w_max * N. The uniform approximation error is bounded by N * max(C*,1)^d(f) * epsilon_Op (simplifies when C* <=1). For f in C^m we obtain optimal B-spline rates. Range bounds are also derived (B_f <= N+1 for additive trees). This addresses the gap on Lipschitz control in deep KAN stacks noted by Liu et al. (2024). Experiments confirm P(KAN)=1.0 for several compositionally structured functions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇偏理论的技术札记，针对具有"组合结构"（可由含 N 个内部节点、每个节点最多依赖 s=O(1) 个变量的有限计算树表示）的连续函数，证明其可由深层 Kolmogorov–Arnold Network (KAN) 表示，且逐层 Lipschitz 乘积 P(KAN)=∏_l max_i M_{l,i} 满足与输入维数 n 无关的上界：对标准算子集 {+,-,×,sin,cos}（× 节点输入限制在 [0,1]）可得 P(KAN)≤1，与 n、N 均无关；同时给出层宽 n_l ≤ n+2w_max·N = O(n+N)、一致逼近误差 ‖f−KAN_f‖_{C^0} ≤ N·max(C_Op,1)^{d(f)}·ε_Op（f∈C^m 时达到最优 B 样条速率 O(N·G^{-(k+1)})）以及值域界 B_f ≤ N+1（加性树紧）等结果，并辅以数值实验（xy、xyz、sin(xy)、x_1⋯x_n，n≤10 均得 P=1.0）。作者明确将其定位为补充 Liu et al. (2024) 原 KAN 论文中未处理的深层 Lipschitz 常数控制问题。
AI.motivation: 经典 Kolmogorov–Arnold 表示定理及其 Sprecher (1965) 细化对任意连续 f∈C^0([0,1]^n) 都给出单变量函数有限叠加的表示，但 Sprecher 构造中内层函数的 Lipschitz 常数随输入维数 n 增长，无法给出与 n 无关的稳定性控制；同时 Liu et al. (2024) 提出的 KAN 架构（原文中第 2.2–2.3 节）并未发展深层 KAN 堆叠中 Lipschitz 常数的控制理论，原始文献的这一空白被作者指出为待解决"gap"。另一方面，对于大量实际函数（符号表达式、经典力学方程、低秩张量分解）其本身具有组合稀疏结构：可写成带固定数量操作符的有限计算树，每个中间子函数只依赖常数个变量。因此需要一种"以组合结构为前提、换取维数无关 Lipschitz 稳定性"的表示方案，并厘清 KAN 逐层 Lipschitz 乘积与整体 Lipschitz 常数之间的本质区别。
AI.method: 方法为"定义-构造-归纳证明"的纯理论路线：(1) 引入架构相关量 P(KAN)=∏_l max_i M_{l,i}（M_{l,i} 为神经元出边最大 Lipschitz 常数），并与 Lip(KAN)=sup_x‖J_KAN(x)‖_op 严格区分（证明 Lip(KAN)≤W^L·P(KAN)，并给出反向 Jacobian 下界 P(KAN)≥‖J_f(x)‖₂/W^L）。(2) 定义 KAN 原语块 ℬ_op（块深度 c_op、块宽 w_op、块 Lipschitz 乘积 Λ_op、对任意 ε 一致逼近 op），并用五种标准算子的显式块构造验证假设 (A5)：+/- 用恒等/符号边（c=1, Λ=1）；sin/cos 用分段线性插值（B 样条 k=1，斜率由中值定理 ≤1，误差 O(G^{-2})）；× 用恒等式 u·v=(u+v)²/4−(u−v)²/4 的三层块，其中 t²/4 可被 k≥2 的 B 样条精确表示，得 Λ_×=1，c_max=3。(3) 收集假设 (A1)–(A5)（有限树、组合稀疏 s=O(1)、算子 Lipschitz、显式值域界、原语块存在），以对内部节点数 N 的归纳证明主定理 Theorem 4.3：块顺序串联构造（子树 g 块 → 子树 h 块 → 根算子块，各层用恒等线转发全部 n 个坐标与中间值），证明 P(KAN_f) ≤ ∏_v max(C_{op(v),D_v},1)^{c_op(v)} ≤ max(C*,1)^{L_f}；层宽按"输入转发 + 块内神经元 + 已完成中间值 ≤ N−1"分解得 n_l ≤ n+2w_max·N；误差用误差组合引理（两步三角不等式，插入 op(ĝ,h)）得 ‖f−KAN_f‖≤N·max(C_Op,1)^{d(f)}·ε_Op。(4) 附录给出对一般紧集 K 的坐标仿射归约（Lemma 3.1，代价 Lip(h^{-1})=1/min_p(b_p−a_p)）。(5) 数值实验：验证 P=1.0、值域规则（2×10^5 采样、1000 随机树）、B 样条误差率常数性验证，并给出 Lean 4/Mathlib 形式化草案（CompGraph 归纳类型 + PrimitiveBlockExists 证明项）。
AI.result: 主要结果：(a) 维数无关主界 P(KAN_f) ≤ ∏_v Λ_{op(v),D_v} ≤ ∏_v max(C_{op(v),D_v},1)^{c_op(v)} ≤ max(C*,1)^{L_f}，其中 L_f=∑_v c_op(v) ≤ c_max·N；对 Op={+,-,×,sin,cos} 且 × 输入 [0,1]-有界时 Λ=1，故 P(KAN_f)≤1，与 n 和 N 均无关（Corollary 4.4）；仅 Lipschitz 联合常数不满足时须用逐节点部分 Lipschitz 常数（Remark 4.5）。(b) 层宽 n_0=n，n_l ≤ n+2w_max·N = O(n+N)（仅证上界，无匹配下界）。(c) 一致误差 ‖f−KAN_f‖_{C^0} ≤ N·max(C_Op,1)^{d(f)}·ε_Op，C_Op≤1 时化为 N·ε_Op；f∈C^m、算子 C^m 时用 k≤m−1 的 B 样条得最优速率 O(N·max(C_Op,1)^{d(f)}·G^{-(k+1)})。(d) 值域界：纯乘性/纯三角树 B_f=1；加性-减性树 B_f≤N+1 且在全加性树取到（x=(1,…,1) 处紧）；Remark 5.2 给出混合 +/× 树中 N+1 失败的显式反例 f=((x1+x2)(x3+x4))(x5+x6)，B_f≤8>6。(e) Corollary 4.6/4.7 推广到非可微 Lipschitz 算子（max(·,0)、|·|、min(·,0)，Λ=1）与 exp（C_Op=e，得 P≤e^{L_f}）。(f) 实验：xy、xyz、sin(xy)、x_1⋯x_n（n 至 10）均得 P(KAN)=1.0，且由恒等线给出 P≥1，故 P=1 精确成立；三次 B 样条误差/h^4 比值 0.019、0.022、0.023 近似常数，验证 O(G^{-4}) 速率。结论同时指出与 Sprecher 构造的对比：后者通用但无 n 无关 Lipschitz 控制。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是：对于"组合稀疏"的连续函数（有限计算树、N 个内部节点、每节点依赖 O(1) 个变量），存在显式构造的深层 KAN 表示，其逐层 Lipschitz 乘积 P(KAN) 与输入维数 n 无关（标准算子集下 P≤1），层宽线性于 n+N，逼近误差达到最优 B 样条速率乘以节点数 N，从而填补 Liu et al. (2024) 遗留的深层 KAN Lipschitz 控制空白，并为分层 KAN（HKAN）等堆叠架构提供了避免 Lipschitz 爆炸的理论模板。作者自陈本文为"简洁的理论札记"，实验仅为 sanity check，不构成全面实证评估。仍存在的开放问题包括：组合稀疏性 (A2) 的一般可验证性（与电路分解相关，可能计算困难，故仅作为显式假设）；层宽上界的紧化与匹配下界；是否存在 P_min 随 n 增长的函数类（以及 P<1 是否可实现）；以及完整的 Lean 4 形式化。需注意的边界：结论严格依赖 (A1)–(A5)，特别是每个节点域上显式原语块的存在性（A5）与显式值域界（A4）；混合 +/× 树会破坏 P≤1 与 B_f≤N+1 的简洁形式；且 P 与真实 Lipschitz 常数不同，Lip(KAN)≤W^L·P 仍随深度指数增长，故"稳定性"仅在逐层乘积这一架构量意义上成立。

title: DSIPA: Detecting LLM-Generated Texts via Sentiment-Invariant Patterns Divergence Analysis
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) presents new security challenges, particularly in detecting machine-generated text used for misinformation, impersonation, and content forgery. Most existing detection approaches struggle with robustness against adversarial perturbation, paraphrasing attacks, and domain shifts, often requiring restrictive access to model parameters or large labeled datasets. To address this, we propose DSIPA, a novel training-free framework that detects LLM-generated content by quantifying sentiment distributional stability under controlled stylistic variation. It is based on the observation that LLMs typically exhibit more emotionally consistent outputs, while human-written texts display greater affective variation. Our framework operates in a zero-shot, black-box manner, leveraging two unsupervised metrics, sentiment distribution consistency and sentiment distribution preservation, to capture these intrinsic behavioral asymmetries without the need for parameter updates or probability access. Extensive experiments are conducted on state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models, including GPT-5.2, Gemini-1.5-pro, Claude-3, and LLaMa-3.3. Evaluations on five domains, such as news articles, programming code, student essays, academic papers, and community comments, demonstrate that DSIPA improves F1 detection scores by up to 49.89% over baseline methods. The framework exhibits superior generalizability across domains and strong resilience to adversarial conditions, providing a robust and interpretable behavioral signal for secure content identification in the evolving LLM landscape.

AI.tldr: DSIPA是一个无需训练的零样本黑盒框架，通过分析情感分布一致性和保持性来检测LLM生成内容。基于"LLM输出通常情感更一致，人类文本情感变化更大"的观察，该方法在5个领域的多种模型上实现了显著的检测性能提升，且对对抗攻击具有强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Rapid advancement of LLMs presents security challenges including misinformation, impersonation, and content forgery. Existing detection methods struggle with robustness against adversarial perturbation, paraphrasing attacks, and domain shifts, and often require restrictive access to model parameters or large labeled datasets.
AI.method: DSIPA operates in a zero-shot, black-box manner by leveraging two unsupervised metrics: sentiment distribution consistency and sentiment distribution preservation. These metrics quantify sentiment distributional stability under controlled stylistic variation to capture behavioral asymmetries between LLM-generated and human-written text.
AI.result: Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art models (GPT-5.2, Gemini-1.5-pro, Claude-3, LLaMa-3.3) across five domains (news, code, essays, academic papers, community comments) demonstrate up to 49.89% F1 improvement over baseline methods.
AI.conclusion: DSIPA provides a robust and interpretable behavioral signal for secure content identification, with superior generalizability across domains and strong resilience to adversarial conditions, achieving up to 49.89% F1 improvement over baselines.

title: Near-Optimal Cryptographic Hardness of Learning With Homogeneous Halfspaces Under Gaussian Marginals
summary: We study three problems that involve identifying homogeneous halfspaces under Gaussian distributions: agnostic learning, one-sided reliable learning, and fairness auditing. In each of these problems, we are given labeled examples $(\mathbf{x}, \mathrm{y})$ drawn from an unknown distribution on $\mathbb{R}^d\times\{-1, +1\}$, whose marginal distribution on $\mathbf{x}$ is standard Gaussian and on $\mathrm{y}$ is arbitrary. The goal of each problem is to output a homogeneous halfspace that approaches the best-fitting homogeneous halfspace in terms of its corresponding loss measure. We prove near-optimal computational hardness results for these problems under the widely believed hardness assumption of the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem. Prior hardness results for these problems were mostly established for general halfspaces; our findings extend some of these hardness results to homogeneous halfspaces. Remarkably, our lower bound strictly generalizes over prior works and narrows the gap between the upper and lower bounds for agnostically learning homogeneous halfspaces under Gaussian marginals.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了高斯分布下齐次半空间的三类问题（不可知学习、单侧可靠学习、公平性审计），在LWE硬度假设下证明了这些问题的近乎最优计算难度下界，将之前针对一般半空间的硬度结果推广到齐次半空间，并缩小了不可知学习问题的已知上下界差距。
AI.motivation: 在机器学习和理论计算机科学中，识别齐次半空间是非常基础的问题。先前关于这些问题的硬度结果大多针对一般半空间，缺乏针对齐次半空间的专门研究；同时，现有的上下界之间存在一定差距。
AI.method: 基于Learning With Errors (LWE)问题的计算硬度假设，通过构造性归约建立了这些问题的计算复杂度下界。
AI.result: 证明了三个问题（不可知学习、单侧可靠学习、公平性审计）在LWE假设下的近乎最优计算硬度，并将之前的硬度结果从一般半空间严格推广到齐次半空间。
AI.conclusion: 研究在LWE假设下证明了三个问题的计算难度的近乎最优下界，并将均匀半空间的已知硬度结果从一般情况推广到齐次情况，同时缩小了高斯边缘分布下均匀半空间不可知学习问题的上下界差距。

title: A Dual-Task Paradigm to Investigate Sentence Comprehension Strategies in Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) behave more like humans when their cognitive resources are restricted, particularly in predicting sentence processing costs such as reading times. However, it remains unclear whether such constraints similarly affect sentence comprehension strategies. Besides, existing methods do not directly target the balance between memory storage and sentence processing, which is central to human working memory. To address this issue, we propose a dual-task paradigm that combines an arithmetic computation task with a sentence comprehension task, such as "The 2 cocktail + blended 3 =..." Our experiments show that under dual-task conditions, GPT-4o, o3-mini, and o4-mini shift toward plausibility-based comprehension, mirroring humans' rational inference. Specifically, these models show a greater accuracy gap between plausible sentences (e.g., "The cocktail was blended by the bartender") and implausible sentences (e.g., "The bartender was blended by the cocktail") in the dual-task condition compared to the single-task conditions. These findings suggest that constraints on the balance between memory and processing resources promote rational inference in LMs. More broadly, they support the view that human-like sentence comprehension fundamentally arises from the allocation of limited cognitive resources.

AI.tldr: 论文通过双任务范式（算术计算+句子理解）探索认知资源约束对语言模型的影响，发现GPT-4o、o3-mini和o4-mini在资源受限下转向基于 plausibility 的理解策略，模拟人类理性推理行为。
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能直接针对人类工作记忆核心——记忆存储与句子处理之间的平衡问题。该研究旨在填补这一空白，探究认知资源约束是否影响语言模型的句子理解策略。
AI.method: 提出双任务范式：结合算术计算任务（如"2 cocktail + blended 3 =..."）与句子理解任务。通过比较单任务与双任务条件下模型对合理句子（如"The cocktail was blended by the bartender"）与不合理句子（如"The bartender was blended by the cocktail"）的准确率差异进行实验。
AI.result: 在双任务条件下，GPT-4o、o3-mini和o4-mini 均表现出向 plausibility-based 理解的转变，合理句子与不合理句子之间的准确率差距增大，镜像人类的理性推理特征。
AI.conclusion: 记忆与处理资源之间的约束促进语言模型的理性推理；人类-like 的句子理解本质上源于有限认知资源的分配。

title: Hierarchical adaptive control for real-time dynamic inference at the edge
comment: Accepted as paper at 5th Real-time And intelliGent Edge computing (RAGE 2026) workshop
summary: Industrial systems increasingly depend on Machine Learning (ML), and operate on heterogeneous nodes that must satisfy tight latency, energy, and memory constraints. Dynamic ML models, which reconfigure their computational footprint at runtime, promise high energy efficiency and lower average latency for modest accuracy tradeoffs; however, their deployment is complex due to the additional hyperparameters they rely on. These hyperparameters, controlling the accuracy versus average latency tradeoff, are often tuned on a calibration dataset that must match the test time distribution, an assumption that rarely holds in real-world scenarios, leading to suboptimal operational conditions, possibly below static models. We propose a two-tier adaptive architecture that co-optimizes model and system decisions. At the global level, a scheduler configures and deploys, for each edge node, a cascade of classifiers composed of lightweight specialized models and a generalist fallback, satisfying latency and memory constraints. At the node level, a local controller tracks data drifts and hardware resources, enabling or disabling specialized predictors (SP) to preserve high energy efficiency and avoid latency-constraint violations under varying conditions. This design allows longer operating times without forcing a global redeployment step, and enables efficient execution in case of an unreachable remote global controller. We evaluate the approach on two datasets under controlled distribution mismatch scenarios, showing average per-inference reductions of latency up to 2.45x and energy up to 2.86x, with less than 4% accuracy drop compared to static baselines. Our contributions are:(1) a budgeted SP-cascade formulation that preserves worst-case latency constraints;(2) a hierarchical controller that maintains efficiency under data and resource changes; and (3) an experimental evaluation on embedded hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两层自适应架构，通过全局调度器和本地控制器协同优化动态ML模型，实现边缘节点上延迟降低2.45倍、能耗降低2.86倍，同时保持精度损失小于4%。
AI.motivation: 动态ML模型依赖校准数据集调优超参数，但测试时分布往往与校准分布不匹配，导致实际部署性能次优，甚至不如静态模型。现有方法缺乏在数据漂移和资源变化下保持效率的机制。
AI.method: 提出两层自适应架构：全局层使用调度器部署由轻量专用模型和通用回退模型组成的级联分类器，满足延迟和内存约束；节点层通过本地控制器追踪数据漂移和硬件资源，动态启用/禁用专用预测器。
AI.result: 在两个数据集和受控分布失配场景下验证，平均每推理延迟降低2.45倍，能耗降低2.86倍，精度损失小于4%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构支持更长运行时间而无需全局重部署，在远程控制器不可达时仍能高效执行，为异构边缘系统上的动态ML部署提供了可行方案。

title: Shorthand for Thought: Compressing LLM Reasoning via Entropy-Guided Supertokens
summary: Reasoning in Large Language Models incurs significant inference-time compute, yet the token-level information structure of reasoning traces remains underexplored. We observe that reasoning tokens split into two functional types: low-entropy \textit{structural} tokens (recurring phrases that scaffold the reasoning process) and higher-entropy \textit{organic} tokens (problem-specific content that drives toward a solution). This asymmetry motivates a simple, model-agnostic compression pipeline: apply cross-word BPE merges on a model's own reasoning traces to derive \textit{supertokens} that capture frequent structural patterns, then teach the model to adopt them via supervised fine-tuning. Across three model families and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, our approach shortens reasoning traces by 8.1\% on average with no statistically significant accuracy loss on any model--benchmark pair. Beyond compression, supertokens act as interpretable reasoning-move annotations (backtracking, verification, strategy shifts), exposing the model's high-level strategy at a glance. Analyzing transitions between structural categories reveals systematic differences between correct and incorrect traces: correct traces show productive recovery (backtracking followed by strategy shifts and verification), while incorrect traces are dominated by confusion cycles (repeated hedging and unresolved contradictions). These diagnostic signals suggest applications in reward shaping and early stopping for RL-based reasoning training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一条"词表级"（而非内容级）的思维链压缩路线：先用 SuperBPE 在模型自身的推理轨迹上做跨词边界 BPE 合并，抽取以低熵结构化短语为主的 supertoken（如 "Let's check"、"Wait, hold on"），追加进基础词表并用均值初始化新 embedding，再仅通过部分解冻的 SFT（前三层+最后一层+embed/lm_head）让模型学会采用这些超词，从而在不删改、不隐藏任何推理步骤、保持轨迹完全可读的前提下，把推理轨迹 token 数平均压缩约 8.1%（各模型 9.2%–11.4%），wall-clock 延迟下降约 10.5%。跨 3 个模型族（QwQ-32B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B）× 5 个数学基准（AIME'24/25、MATH-500、Minerva、OlympiadBench）的 TOST 等价性检验显示 3/15 通过、11/15 不确定、1/15 失败（DS-R1-Llama 在 MATH-500 上 −3.3pp）。附带贡献是把 supertoken 按 9 类推理动作（回退、验证、策略切换、犹豫、反驳、计算等）打标，可作"推理路标"读出正确轨迹的"生产性恢复"与错误轨迹的"困惑循环"。注意：摘要版本声称"任何模型–基准组合上均无统计显著精度损失"，与正文 1/15 FAIL 的结论不一致，应以正文为准。
AI.motivation: LLM 的长链式思维（long-CoT）推理带来巨大的推理期算力开销，但既有压缩工作大多停留在"内容层"：剪枝、摘要、蒸馏或用潜表示替换显式步骤（TokenSkip、R1-Compress、ConMax、Coconut、Token Assorted 等），既损失可读性/可监督性，又在长 CoT 上带来可观的精度代价（独立复现显示 TokenSkip 在同等压缩下掉 20pp 以上）。而推理输出"内容本身"的信息结构（哪些 token 是承重的、哪些只是脚手架）仍缺乏系统刻画。作者的核心观察是：推理 token 并非同质流，而是两类功能不同的人群——低熵的"结构性" token（反复出现的模板化短语，如回退提示 "Wait, hold on"、验证短语 "let's check"、策略切换 "Let me try"）与高熵的"有机" token（数学表达式、变量绑定、中间结果等真正推进解题的内容）。前者一旦短语开头，后续 token 近乎确定性，逐 token 生成所付出的算力与其信息量不成比例。作者因此主张：保持训练固定、改变词表，把这些低熵高频跨 token 跨度"物化"为单个 supertoken，做无损的"表达层"压缩，而非"内容层"删减。同时提出 supertoken 可作为可解释的推理动作标注，用于诊断正确/错误推理的结构差异。
AI.method:
**（1）信息论建模。** 以 Shannon 条件熵 H_θ(t_i | t_<i) 度量每个 token 在其前缀下的不确定性；定义合并跨度 M 的平均熵 h_M 与参与合并的 token 比例 ρ=|M|/n，给出压缩上界 Δ = ρ·(1 − h_M/log2|V|)。当 h_M ≪ log2|V| 时 Δ≈ρ，即合并跨度内几乎所有 token 都可被吸收，故"学习高频模式的 BPE"应优先发现结构序列。

**（2）词表构建（SuperBPE）。** 对每个目标模型，用其在 OpenThoughts3 prompt 上自采的推理轨迹作语料计算 n-gram 计数（每样本计数上限 10，防止复读样本主导合并选择）。设计"结构过滤器"，只保留四类表层模式：句首大写短语跨度（如 "The answer is"）、标点+换行续接、逗号引导续接、空格前缀单个数字（排除多位数拼接）；这把 1000 merges 时的原始压缩率从约 28% 降到约 10%，并产出语义连贯的推理短语（"Let's check"、"Let's reconsider" 等）。按语料频次保留 top-K=250 个 merge（Qwen 族词表 151,669→151,919）。新 token embedding 用其组成 token embedding 的均值初始化——作者定性报告随机初始化在同等训练预算下无法稳定收敛、无法形成可用采用率（定性观察，非受控消融）。推理/训练时先走原 tokenizer，再以后处理方式套用 supertoken 合并，保持与原模型兼容。

**（3）采用训练（SFT）。** 在 OpenThoughts3（约 114K 样本，assistant turn 应用扩展词表）上 SFT，比较三种模式：(i) 仅训练 embed_tokens/lm_head 的新行；(ii) LoRA（r=16, α=32，作用于注意力投影 + embedding 行）；(iii) 部分解冻（首 N=3 层 + 末 M=1 层 + embedding/lm_head）。所有模式用梯度 hook 将基础词表行清零，使梯度只更新 supertoken embedding。主表结果统一用 (iii)，超参（lr 2e-4、余弦衰减、3% warmup、1 epoch、per-device bs 1×16 梯度累积=128、bf16、Flash Attention 2、梯度检查点、FSDP 全分片、8×H200）跨全部 15 个 cell 固定，无逐 cell 调参。

**（4）熵验证。** 用 QwQ-32B 作生成与打分器，在 OpenThoughts3-1.2M 的 10,000 条轨迹（115M token）上算逐 token 条件熵，按字符偏移对齐基础/扩展分词，把 token 分为 non-merged / merge head / continuation 三角色。跨模型复核：用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 对同一批 QwQ-32B 轨迹重新打分。

**（5）评测。** 5 个数学基准零样本评测，vLLM 于 2×H200，每评测跑 5 次取均值，报准确率、完成 token 数、supertoken 采用率；关键对照为 "SFT（无 supertoken）"——同数据、同超参、不扩词表，用以隔离压缩来源。统计上对每 cell 计算 5 次平均的逐题配对正确率，做 TOST 等价性检验（±2pp margin，配对 t 检验，df=N−1，PASS/不确定/FAIL 三档）；对 token 差做配对 95% CI（σ_paired≈0.24×T̄）。另测 wall-clock 延迟、IFEval 通用指令遵循、训练模式消融、LoRA rank 扫描、过滤器强度前沿。

**（6）结构分析。** 用固定优先级顺序的确定性关键词/正则规则把 250 个 supertoken 全部归入 9 类（Backtracking、Hedging、Verification、Counterargument、Strategy Shift、Problem Ref.、Sequencing、Reasoning、Computation，N 合计=250，无"其他"残留），再统计类别转移 bigram 的过度表征比。
AI.result:
**压缩效果。** 主配置（强过滤、K=250）下推理轨迹 token 数平均下降约 8.1%（论文口径；Table 2 分模型为 QwQ-32B 9.17%、Qwen3-30B-A3B 11.2%、DS-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 11.4%，单 cell 区间约 −0.1% 至 −17.0%）。对照实验 "SFT（无 supertoken）" 平均仅 −0.47%（与 0 等价），说明压缩来自词表扩展而非 SFT 本身的行为缩短，即"用更少 token 表达同样的推理内容"。15 个 cell 中 9 个 token 降幅的配对 95% CI 排除 0；AIME（N=30）多数不显著，但 DS-R1 的 −17% 显著。

**精度。** TOST（±2pp）：3/15 PASS（QwQ-32B/MATH-500、QwQ-32B/OlympiadBench、Qwen3-30B-A3B/MATH-500），11/15 不确定（多为 AIME N=30 检验力不足），1/15 FAIL——DS-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 在 MATH-500 上 Δ=−3.3pp，90% CI [−5.38, −1.22]，属真实精度损失且成因未确证（该模型恰是压缩最激进者）。Qwen 族平均分别为 +0.8pp、+0.3pp。

**延迟。** 平均 wall-clock 下降约 10.5%（QwQ −13.8%、Qwen3 −13.4%、DS −4.8%，论文正文另处写 14.1/13.1/4.4，存在口径不一致），多数 cell 延迟降幅超过 token 降幅。

**熵证据。** 合并覆盖 ρ=15.2% 的 token 位置；continuation 熵相对非合并 token 降低 33%（长度 2）到 79%（长度 ≥16），长度 3 为反例（与过渡 token 集中有关）；自打分下非合并 1.27 bits、merge head 1.13、continuation 1.01；h_M/log2|V|≈0.06 → 理论上界 Δ=14.3%（Δ/ρ≈0.94），跨域（数学 14.9%、代码 13.6%、科学 11.5%）稳定。跨模型打分时熵序保持且结构/有机间隙从 0.26 扩至 0.62 bits（r=0.77–0.84），说明该现象非生成模型自身分布的伪影。

**过滤强度与稳健性。** 轻过滤（K=1000，561 个条目）离线天花板 11.8%、实测 −8.5%，比强过滤多约 67% 相对压缩而代价 0.8pp 宏平均准确率（集中在 AIME）；完全不过滤（K=1000）虽离线达 17.7%，却出现生成长度 +25%、宏平均准确率从 0.63 崩到 0.40——因为 supertoken 与其基础拼写之间概率质量分裂（"0" vs " "+"0"），模型无法二选一。留出检验：在留出的 20/120 shard（20 万轨迹、1.01B token）上用同一过滤重推词表得 954 merges，节省 7.64% vs 生产词表 757 merges 的 7.36%，生产 top-100 合并短语有 80.6% 出现在留出 top-100。

**训练方式。** Embedding-only 能被采用但精度受损（QwQ-32B AIME'24 70.0、MATH-500 71.4）；LoRA 各 rank（1/2/4/8/16）均稳定采用（10–13%）但 token 数不降甚至高于基线；部分解冻在采用率与压缩率上均最优——即"学会用 supertoken"与"学会用 supertoken 压缩"是两个需要不同模型灵活度的过程。

**通用能力与结构诊断。** IFEval 的 strict prompt/instruction 准确率前后基本持平，说明扩词表 + SFT 未损伤通用指令遵循。正确轨迹呈现"生产性恢复"（Problem Ref.→Strategy Shift 3.0×、Verification→Strategy Shift 2.1×、Reasoning→Verification 1.6×、Backtracking→Strategy Shift 1.5×），错误轨迹呈现"困惑循环"（Sequencing→Sequencing 3.7×、Problem Ref.→Hedging 2.1×、Counterargument→Problem Ref. 2.0×、Hedging→Hedging 1.4×、Counterargument→Counterargument 1.3×）；作者明确声明这是评估池上的聚合相关性描述，而非留出集上的正确性预测。

**报告不一致之处。** 摘要称"任何模型–基准组合均无统计显著精度损失"，与正文 1/15 FAIL 矛盾；8.1% 的平均压缩口径与 Table 2 的 9.17/11.2/11.4（均值约 10.6%）亦不一致；延迟降幅存在 10.5% 与 14.1/13.1/4.4 两套数字。
AI.conclusion:
本文的核心主张是：推理轨迹中存在大量重复的、低熵的"脚手架"，把它们升格为词表条目（supertoken）即可在**不删除、不摘要、不潜化任何推理步骤**的前提下实现无损压缩，得到"压缩后的表达"而非"删减后的内容"，从而保留完整、语法通顺、人类可读的推理链，对调试与监督有意义。与内容级/潜表示级方法（30–70% 压缩但破坏可解释性且有精度代价）相比，8.1% 属于"温和"档位；但作者主张其正确的参照系是 tokenizer 改进类文献（典型语料级增益仅 1–2%，如 PickyBPE 约 1.1%），故该幅度相对可观——并把压缩率呈现为"压缩–可解释性前沿上的一点"而非框架固有属性（过滤器强度是最主要的调节杠杆）。方法成本结构也不同：仅需一轮小规模普通 SFT（4–12 小时、8×H200），无奖励模型、无控制器、无推理期路由，扩展后的 tokenizer+模型是永久 drop-in 替换、零请求开销，一次训练摊薄到后续所有推理。

局限：压缩比低于内容级方法；评测仅限数学推理（代码、智能体规划、科学/长文本 QA 未验证，尽管捕获的多为"let me think"/"wait"/"verify"等域通用推理标记）；依赖目标模型的代表性轨迹，且词表跨 tokenizer 家族的迁移性未验证；DS-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 上存在真实精度退化且机制未查清（作者计划用第二个 Llama 族模型区分 tokenizer 家族效应与模型特异效应）；转移模式仅为相关性，尚未证明超 token 的 bigram 特征在留出集上超出"轨迹长度"等简单基线带来预测增益。

后续方向：将结构信号用于 RL 推理训练的 reward shaping 与 early stopping；扩展到非数学领域；考察更强的合并/过滤策略与压缩-可解释性权衡。代码与分类脚本已开源（github.com/Writer/shorthand-for-thought）。

title: Text Style Transfer with Machine Translation for Graphic Designs
summary: Globalization of graphic designs such as those used in marketing materials and magazines is increasingly important for communication to broad audiences. To accomplish this, the textual content in the graphic designs needs to be accurately translated and have the text styling preserved in order to fit visually into the design. Preserving text styling requires high accuracy word alignment between the original and the translated text. The problem of word alignment between source and translated text is long known. The industry standards for extracting word alignments are defined by Giza++ and attention probabilities from neural machine translation (NMT) models. In this paper, we explore three new methods to tackle the word alignment problem for transferring text styles from the source to the translated text. The proposed methods are developed on top of commercially available NMT and LLM translation technologies. They include: NMT with custom input and output tags for text styling; LLM with custom input and output tags; a hybrid with NMT for translation followed by an LLM with use of unigram mappings. To analyze the performance of these solutions, their alignment results are compared with the results of an attention head approach to gauge their usability in graphic design applications. Interestingly, the attention head strong baseline proves more accurate than the LLM or NMT approach and on par with the hybrid NMT+LLM approach.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在图形设计中迁移文本样式的词对齐问题，提出三种基于NMT和LLM的新方法，并与传统注意力头方法进行比较，发现注意力头基线方法表现优于单独使用NMT或LLM的方法，与混合NMT+LLM方法相当。
AI.motivation: 全球化营销材料设计需要准确翻译文本内容并保留原始文本样式（如字体、颜色、布局等），这依赖于源语言与目标语言之间的高精度词对齐技术。传统方法依赖Giza++和NMT注意力概率，但在商业翻译工具上的应用效果有待探索。
AI.method: 提出三种基于商业NMT和LLM翻译技术的方法：(1) 带自定义输入输出标签的NMT；(2) 带自定义输入输出标签的LLM；(3) NMT翻译+LLM结合unigram映射的混合方法。使用注意力头方法作为基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，注意力头强基线方法在词对齐准确性上优于单独的LLM或NMT方法，并与混合NMT+LLM方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 对于图形设计中的文本样式迁移任务，传统的注意力头方法仍然有效且准确；LLM和NMT虽为新技术，但在词对齐任务上尚未展现出显著优势；混合方法可能是一种有潜力的折中方案。

title: Do Larger Models Really Win in Drug Discovery? A Benchmark Assessment of Model Scaling in AI-Driven Molecular Property and Activity Prediction
summary: The rapid growth of molecular foundation models and general-purpose large language models has encouraged a scale-centric view of artificial intelligence in drug discovery, in which larger pretrained models are expected to supersede compact cheminformatics models and task-specific graph neural networks (GNNs). We test this assumption on 22 molecular property and activity endpoints, including public ADMET and Tox21 benchmarks and two internal anti-infective activity datasets. Across 167,056 held-out task--molecule evaluations under structure-similarity-separated five-fold cross-validation (37,756 ADMET, 77,946 Tox21, 49,266 anti-TB and 2,088 antimalaria), classical machine-learning (ML) models such as RF(ECFP4) and ExtraTrees(RDKit descriptors) win ten primary-metric tasks, GNNs such as GIN and Ligandformer win nine, and pretrained molecular sequence models such as MoLFormer and ChemBERTa2 win three. Rule-based SAR reasoning baselines, represented by GPT5.5-SAR and Opus4.7-SAR, do not win under the prespecified primary metrics, although train-fold-derived SAR knowledge provides measurable but uneven gains for SAR reasoning and interpretation. These results indicate that compact, specialized models remain highly effective for molecular property and activity prediction. The performance differences among classical ML, GNN and pretrained sequence models are often modest and endpoint-dependent, whereas larger or more general models do not provide a universal predictive advantage. Large models may still add value for zero-shot reasoning, SAR interpretation and hypothesis generation, but the results suggest that predictive performance depends on the alignment among molecular representation, inductive bias, data regime, endpoint biology and validation protocol.

AI.tldr: 本研究在22个分子性质/活性预测任务上系统比较了167,056次评估，系统性挑战了"更大预训练模型必然优于紧凑专业模型"的假设。结果表明：经典ML模型(RF/ECFP4, ExtraTrees/RDKit描述符)赢得10项任务，GNN模型(GIN, Ligandformer)赢得9项任务，而大规模预训练序列模型(MoLFormer, ChemBERTa2)仅赢得3项任务。
AI.motivation: 当前分子AI领域存在"规模至上"的观点，认为更大的预训练模型将取代紧凑的化学信息学模型和特定任务的GNN。该研究旨在实证检验这一假设，通过在多样化基准数据集上直接对比多类模型的实际预测性能。
AI.method: 采用结构相似性分离的五折交叉验证，在ADMET、Tox21及两个内部抗感染数据集上共进行167,056次评估。对比了经典ML(RF、ExtraTrees)、GNN(GIN、Ligandformer)、预训练序列模型(MoLFormer、ChemBERTa2)及基于规则的SAR推理基线。
AI.result: 紧凑专业模型表现优异：经典ML赢得10项、GNN赢得9项、预训练序列模型仅赢得3项主指标任务。SAR推理模型虽未在主指标上胜出，但其从训练集衍生的SAR知识可提供不均衡的增益。
AI.conclusion: 更大或更通用的模型并未提供普遍预测优势；预测性能取决于分子表示方法、归纳偏置、数据规模、端点生物学特性及验证协议之间的对齐。大型模型可能在零样本推理、SAR解释和假设生成方面仍有价值。

title: SG-UniBuc-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Multi-Head RoBERTa with Chunking for Long-Context Evasion Detection
comment: Accepted to SemEval-2026 (Task 6: CLARITY: Unmasking Political Question Evasions)
summary: We describe our system for SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY: Unmasking Political Question Evasions), which classifies English political interview responses by coarse-grained clarity (3-way) and fine-grained evasion strategy (9-way). Since responses frequently exceed the 512-token limit of standard Transformer encoders, we apply an overlapping sliding-window chunking strategy with element-wise Max-Pooling aggregation over chunk representations. A shared RoBERTa-large encoder supplies two task-specific heads trained jointly via a multi-task objective, with inference-time ensembling over 7-fold stratified cross-validation. Our system achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.80 on Subtask 1 and 0.51 on Subtask 2, ranking 11th in both subtasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个用于SemEval-2026 CLARITY任务的系统，对政治采访回应进行3分类清晰度判断和9分类规避策略识别。针对长文本序列超过Transformer 512 token限制的问题，采用重叠滑动窗口分块策略和Max-Pooling聚合方法。在两个子任务上均获得第11名，Macro-F1分别为0.80和0.51。
AI.motivation: 解决政治采访回应中问题规避行为的自动识别问题，帮助公众更好地理解和评估政治人物的回应质量。
AI.method: 1) 使用重叠滑动窗口分块处理长文本；2) 对分块表征进行逐元素Max-Pooling聚合；3) 共享RoBERTa-large编码器+双任务专用头；4) 多任务联合训练；5) 7折分层交叉验证集成推理。
AI.result: Subtask 1（3分类）Macro-F1=0.80，Subtask 2（9分类）Macro-F1=0.51，双双获得第11名。
AI.conclusion: 共享编码器+多任务学习框架有效，滑动窗口策略解决了长文本限制问题，但细粒度规避策略识别（9分类）仍是挑战。

title: Lyapunov-Guided Self-Alignment: Test-Time Adaptation for Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at AISTATS 2026. First two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://seungyubhan.github.io/sas/. Code: https://github.com/seungyubhan/sas
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) agents often fail when deployed, as the gap between training datasets and real environments leads to unsafe behavior. To address this, we present SAS (Self-Alignment for Safety), a transformer-based framework that enables test-time adaptation in offline safe RL without retraining. In SAS, the main mechanism is self-alignment: at test time, the pretrained agent generates several imagined trajectories and selects those satisfying the Lyapunov condition. These feasible segments are then recycled as in-context prompts, allowing the agent to realign its behavior toward safety while avoiding parameter updates. In effect, SAS turns Lyapunov-guided imagination into control-invariant prompts, and its transformer architecture admits a hierarchical RL interpretation where prompting functions as Bayesian inference over latent skills. Across Safety Gymnasium and MuJoCo benchmarks, SAS consistently reduces cost and failure while maintaining or improving return.

AI.tldr: SAS是一种基于Transformer的框架，通过自对齐机制将Lyapunov引导的轨迹想象转化为控制不变上下文提示，实现离线安全RL的测试时自适应，无需重训练即可重新对齐智能体行为使其符合安全约束。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习智能体在部署时经常失败，因为训练数据集与真实环境之间的差距导致不安全行为。
AI.method: 提出SAS（Self-Alignment for Safety）框架：1）采用基于Transformer的架构实现测试时自适应；2）核心机制为自对齐：预训练智能体在测试时生成多个想象轨迹，选择满足Lyapunov条件的可行段；3）将可行段回收为上下文提示，使智能体在避免参数更新的前提下重新对齐安全行为；4）Transformer架构支持层次化RL解释，其中提示函数作为潜技能的贝叶斯推断。
AI.result: 在Safety Gymnasium和MuJoCo基准测试中，SAS持续降低代价和失败率，同时保持或提升回报。
AI.conclusion: SAS通过自对齐机制和Lyapunov引导的轨迹选择作为上下文提示，有效解决了离线安全强化学习中的模拟到现实差距问题，在无需重训练的情况下实现安全行为的在线适应。

title: When Hidden States Drift: Can KV Caches Rescue Long-Range Speculative Decoding?
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but SOTA hidden-state-based drafters suffer from long-range decay: draft accuracy degrades as the speculative step increases. Existing work attributes this decay to train-inference mismatch and proposes test-time training (TTT) as a remedy, yet we observe that long-range decay persists even in TTT-trained drafters. We revisit long-range decay from the perspective of context information preservation. In hidden-state reuse, we argue the target hidden state acts as a biased context compression: it aggregates historical token information according to the attention query at the current position, yielding a compact representation optimized for immediate next-token prediction. This compression can suppress information less relevant to the current query but important for later speculative steps. In contrast, the target model's KV cache serves as an explicit context, retaining the complete set of token-wise KV representations. We therefore posit the KV-Reuse Hypothesis: allowing the draft model to reuse the target KV cache can provide richer signals for long-horizon drafting. To test this hypothesis, we introduce KVShot, a diagnostic framework that compares three reuse paradigms: hidden-only, KV-only, and hybrid. Extensive evaluations on Qwen3-8B show that KV-Reuse improves long-range acceptance, although end-to-end speedups remain marginal under current training pipelines. Our analysis identifies two key structural bottlenecks: shallow drafters struggle to estimate target queries accurately, and draft-side KV projections receive sparse gradient signals. These findings suggest that realizing the full potential of KV-aware decoding requires moving beyond TTT toward block-wise training paradigms. By exposing these bottlenecks, KVShot provides a foundational diagnostic testbed and a clear roadmap for designing next-generation inference architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了推测解码中的长距离精度衰减问题，从上下文信息保持角度提出KV-Reuse假设，即允许draft模型复用target模型的KV cache可为长程推测提供更丰富的信号。实验表明KV-Reuse能提升长距离接受率，但受限于浅层drafter查询估计不准确和KV投影梯度信号稀疏两大结构瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 推测解码虽能加速LLM推理，但现有基于隐藏状态的draft模型存在严重的长距离衰减问题——推测步数增加时draft精度下降。尽管test-time training (TTT)被提出作为补救措施，但作者观察到TTT训练的drafter仍无法解决长距离衰减问题，这促使研究者重新审视问题的根本原因。
AI.method: 作者从上下文信息保持角度分析，发现target hidden state本质上是"有偏的上下文压缩"——它根据当前位置的attention query聚合历史token信息，生成针对即时下一个token预测优化的紧凑表示，可能抑制对后续推测步骤重要的信息。而target模型的KV cache则保留完整的token级KV表示。因此提出KV-Reuse假设，允许draft模型复用target KV cache。研究者设计了KVShot诊断框架，对比三种复用范式：hidden-only、KV-only和hybrid。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上的广泛评估表明，KV-Reuse确实改善了长距离接受率，但端到端加速效果仍然有限。分析揭示两个关键结构瓶颈：(1) 浅层drafter难以准确估计target查询；(2) draft侧KV投影接收到的梯度信号稀疏。这些发现表明实现KV感知解码的潜力需要超越TTT，转向block-wise训练范式。
AI.conclusion: KVShot提供了基础性诊断测试平台和清晰的研究路线图。KV-Reuse虽能改善长程推测精度，但当前训练pipeline下端到端加速效果有限。核心瓶颈在于浅层架构与稀疏梯度的结构性限制，未来需探索block-wise训练范式以充分发挥KV-aware解码的潜力。

title: Large-scale semi-supervised learning with online spectral graph sparsification
comment: Workshop on Resource-Efficient Machine Learning (REML), ICML 2015
summary: We introduce Sparse-HFS, a scalable algorithm that can compute solutions to SSL problems using only O(n polylog(n)) space and O(m polylog(n)) time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sparse-HFS 算法：在半流式（仅边插入）图流场景下，利用 Kelner–Levin 在线谱稀疏化与 SDD 线性求解器增量构建稀疏近似图 H，从而在 O(n polylog(n)) 空间、O(m polylog(n)) 时间内求解 stable-HFS 半监督学习问题，并给出与精确 stable-HFS 相同收敛阶的泛化误差上界。
AI.motivation: 图上的半监督学习（SSL）通过标签沿图结构传播来利用大量无标签样本，典型方法如谐函数解（HFS）需求解涉及图拉普拉斯矩阵的线性系统，但稠密图上时间复杂度高达 O(n^3)、空间复杂度 O(n^2)，在大规模 n 下不可行；同时实践中常受限于内存与算力预算，甚至无法把完整相似度矩阵存入内存。因此需要一种既不存储整图、又能保持理论泛化保证的可扩展算法。
AI.method: 以 stable-HFS（Belkin 等人的调和函数解加零均值约束 F = {f: ⟨f,1⟩=0}）为求解对象：f̂ = (γ l L_G + I_S)^+ y_S。1) 采用 Kelner–Levin 的插入式流谱稀疏化算法（Alg. 2）：依据有效电阻 R_e = b_e^T L_H^+ b_e 做加权采样，新边以 Binomial(N, p̃_e') 方式并入稀疏图 H，且保证 H 是 G 的 (1±ε) 谱稀疏化器（(1-ε)x^T L_G x ≤ x^T L_H x ≤ (1+ε)x^T L_G x）。2) 稀疏图求解：用 SDD 矩阵迭代线性求解器（Koutis 等）计算各边有效电阻并更新 f̃ = A^{-1} y_S，A = P_F(lγ L_H + I_S)，其中 P_F = L L^+ 为投影矩阵。3) 算法 1（Sparse-HFS）：累积边至 |A| ≤ n log²(n)/ε² 后触发一次稀疏化更新，整体更新代价 O(n polylog(n))。4) 理论分析：先证稀疏化近似的经验误差增量 ≤ l²γ²λ_n²k²ε²/(lγ(1-ε)λ_1-1)⁴，再证 β-稳定性（|f(x)-y(x)|²-|f'(x)-y(x)|²| ≤ β），β ≤ 1.5k√l/(lγ(1-ε)λ_1-1)² + √2 k/(lγ(1-ε)λ_1-1)，最后结合 Bousquet–Elisseeff 集中不等式得最终界。
AI.result: 定理 1：R(f̃) ≤ R̂(f̂) + l²γ²λ_n²k²ε²/(lγ(1-ε)λ_1-1)⁴ + β + (2β + c²(l+u)/(lu))·√(π(l,u)ln(1/δ)/2)，其中 π(l,u)= lu/(l+u-0.5)·1/(1-1/(2max{l,u}))。当 ε 固定时，近似误差项按 1/l² 缩放，被同阶的 β 项遮蔽，故近似算法与精确 stable-HFS 收敛阶相同，可自由权衡精度与计算量。实验：在 n=12100 的 R² 双簇数据上构建 k-近邻图（k=100…12000，m 从 1.21×10⁶ 到 1.38×10⁸），取 4 个标签点，γ=1、ε=0.8。两种算法均在 k>4000 后才恢复较好精度（此前簇间不连通无法传播标签）；稀疏化版本精度与 stable-HFS 接近，最优点 k=4500 时稀疏图仅含原图约 10% 的边而精度相当。空间 O(n polylog(n))、时间 O(m polylog(n))，每条原图边摊还 O(polylog(n))。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-HFS 证明了谱稀疏化可与 SSL 求解器结合，在半流式（仅插入）图流下以近线性代价获得与精确算法同阶的泛化误差保证。局限与未来工作：当前仅支持边插入流；处理边删除需要 sketch 隐式表示，其计算复杂度 O(n² polylog(n)) 在大规模下不可接受，如何在计算高效前提下将稀疏化扩展到完全动态场景仍是开放问题。

title: EmoTransCap: Dataset and Pipeline for Emotion Transition-Aware Speech Captioning in Discourses
summary: Emotion perception and adaptive expression are fundamental capabilities in human-agent interaction. While recent advances in speech emotion captioning (SEC) have improved fine-grained emotional modeling, existing systems remain limited to static, single-emotion characterization within isolated sentences, neglecting dynamic emotional transitions at the discourse level. To address this gap, we propose Emotion Transition-Aware Speech Captioning (EmoTransCap), a paradigm that integrates temporal emotion dynamics with discourse-level speech description. To construct a dataset rich in emotion transitions while enabling scalable expansion, we design an automated pipeline for dataset creation. This is the first large-scale dataset explicitly designed to capture discourse-level emotion transitions. To generate semantically rich descriptions, we incorporate acoustic attributes and temporal cues from discourse-level speech. Our Multi-Task Emotion Transition Recognition (MTETR) model performs joint emotion transition detection and diarization. Leveraging the semantic analysis capabilities of LLMs, we produce two annotation versions: descriptive and instruction-oriented. These data and annotations offer a valuable resource for advancing emotion perception and emotional expressiveness. The dataset enables speech captions that capture emotional transitions, facilitating temporal-dynamic and fine-grained emotion understanding. We also introduce a controllable, transition-aware emotional speech synthesis system at the discourse level, enhancing anthropomorphic emotional expressiveness and supporting emotionally intelligent conversational agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出情感转换感知语音描述(EmoTransCap)新范式，解决现有语音情感识别仅关注静态单情感的问题。通过自动化流程构建大规模情感转换数据集，引入多任务情感转换识别模型(MTETR)，结合大语言模型生成两种标注版本，实现话语层面的动态情感理解和可控制的情感语音合成。
AI.motivation: 现有语音情感描述系统局限于静态、单一情感表征，忽视话语层面的动态情感转换；缺乏能够捕捉情感过渡的大规模数据集；无法支持具有情感智能的对话智能体。
AI.method: 1) 设计自动化数据集构建流程；2) 提出多任务情感转换识别模型(MTETR)进行联合情感转换检测和说话人分离；3) 利用LLM生成描述性和指令性两类标注；4) 开发可控的转换感知情感语音合成系统。
AI.result: 构建首个专注于话语层面情感转换的大规模数据集；实现捕捉情感转换的语音描述；支持时序动态和细粒度情感理解；增强拟人化情感表达能力。
AI.conclusion: EmoTransCap范式和相应数据集为情感感知和情感表达研究提供了宝贵资源，有望推动情感智能对话系统的发展。

title: Advancing multi-site emission control: A physics-informed transfer learning framework with mixture of experts for carbon-pollutant synergy
comment: Supplementary materials will be released after the final version is finalized
summary: Municipal solid waste incineration is increasingly central to urban waste management, yet its sustainability benefit depends on controlling carbon emissions and multiple air pollutants under highly heterogeneous operating conditions. Current data-driven models are often accurate within individual plants but are difficult to transfer across facilities, limiting their value for scalable emission-control strategies. Here we show that multi-site emission behaviour can be represented through transferable system-level structures when physical constraints, operating-regime heterogeneity and carbon--pollutant coupling are jointly considered. We develop a physics-informed transfer learning framework built on a carbon--pollutant mixture-of-experts model, which combines regime-dependent expert routing with conservation-based regularization and a carbon--pollutant synergistic index for integrated risk evaluation. Across 13 municipal solid waste incineration plants, the model captured both pollutant-specific emissions and system-level risk, achieving source-domain average pollutant $R^2$ values of 0.668--0.904 and CPSI $R^2$ values of 0.666--0.970. After transfer from a reference facility to 12 target plants, average pollutant $R^2$ remained between 0.661 and 0.842, while CPSI retained comparable transferability ($R^2$ = 0.610--0.841). Expert-utilization patterns further indicate that adaptation occurs through structured re-weighting of operating regimes rather than complete model re-learning. By extending the learned representation into an interpretable digital twin, this framework provides a route from emission prediction to regime-aware operational navigation, supporting scalable carbon--pollutant synergistic control across heterogeneous waste-to-energy systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个物理信息驱动的迁移学习框架，用于生活垃圾焚烧厂的碳-污染物协同排放预测与控制。通过混合专家模型、区域依赖路由、守恒正则化和CPSI综合风险指数，实现了跨13个设施的高精度迁移预测，污染物R²达0.66-0.90，CPSI R²达0.61-0.97，为异构垃圾能源系统提供了可解释的数字孪生和区域感知运营导航能力。
AI.motivation: 城市生活垃圾焚烧在碳排放和多种空气污染物控制方面面临挑战，当前数据驱动模型在单厂内准确但跨厂迁移性差，难以支撑规模化排放控制策略的制定。
AI.method: 提出了基于碳-污染物混合专家模型的物理信息迁移学习框架，融合了区域依赖的专家路由机制、基于守恒的正则化约束，以及用于综合风险评估的碳-污染物协同指数(CPSI)；通过13个生活垃圾焚烧厂的验证，利用源域到目标域的知识迁移实现跨设施建模。
AI.result: 源域中污染物R²达0.668-0.904，CPSI R²达0.666-0.970；迁移至12个目标厂后，污染物R²保持0.661-0.842，CPSI R²达0.610-0.841；专家利用模式显示适应过程通过结构化运营区域重加权实现而非完全模型重训练。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的物理信息迁移学习框架为异构固废能源系统提供了从排放预测到区域感知运营导航的可行路径，支持跨设施的碳-污染物协同控制规模化应用。

title: Naamah: A Large Scale Synthetic Sanskrit NER Corpus via DBpedia Seeding and LLM Generation
summary: The digitisation of classical Sanskrit literature is impeded by a scarcity of annotated resources, particularly for Named Entity Recognition. While recent methodologies utilise generic Large Language Models (LLMs) for data augmentation, these approaches remain prone to error and often lack the reasoning depth required for classical grammar. In this work, we introduce Naamah, a high quality silver standard Sanskrit NER dataset comprising 102,942 sentences. We propose a methodology that combines entity extraction from DBpedia with the generative capabilities of a 24B parameter hybrid reasoning model to create grammatically natural and synthetically diverse training data. We utilize this dataset to benchmark two transformer architectures: the massive multilingual XLM RoBERTa and the parameter efficient IndicBERTv2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Naamah，一个包含102,942个句子的高质量银标准梵语命名实体识别数据集，利用DBpedia实体提取和24B参数混合推理模型生成语法自然且多样化合成训练数据，并基于XLM RoBERTa和IndicBERTv2进行基准测试。
AI.motivation: 梵语古典文学数字化受限于标注资源匮乏，现有基于通用大语言模型的数据增强方法存在错误率高、缺乏古典语法推理深度的问题。
AI.method: 1) 从DBpedia提取实体；2) 使用24B参数混合推理模型生成语法自然且合成多样的训练数据；3) 构建Naamah数据集（102,942句子）；4) 使用XLM RoBERTa和IndicBERTv2进行基准测试。
AI.result: 研究提供了高质量银标准数据集和模型基准测试结果，验证了混合推理模型在梵语NER数据增强中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法成功构建了大规模梵语NER数据集，为古典语言数字化提供了重要资源支撑。

title: PAINT: Partial-Solution Adaptive Interpolated Training for Self-Distilled Reasoners
summary: Improving large language model (LLM) reasoning requires supervision that is both aligned with the model's own test-time states and informative at the token level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides on-policy exploration but offers sparse, high-variance credit; supervised fine-tuning and distillation provide dense targets but often train on fixed trajectories or rely on stronger teachers. Recent privileged on-policy self-distillation explores a middle ground by scoring student rollouts with the same model under verified solution context. We revisit this setting through a contextual re-scoring lens: for reasoning, the important choices are not only whether privileged context is available, but how much of it should be revealed and where its distribution should shape the student. We propose PAINT (Partial-solution Adaptive INterpolated Training), which masks the verified solution according to rollout-reference overlap and applies a small energy-space interpolation on a sparse set of entropy-mismatch token positions. Across competition-level math benchmarks, PAINT consistently improves over a strong prior on-policy self-distillation baseline at all three Qwen3 scales. On Qwen3-8B, it raises macro Avg@12 by 2.1 points over this prior baseline and 2.9 points over GRPO.

AI.tldr: PAINT（Partial-solution Adaptive INterpolated Training）是一种新型的LLM推理训练方法，通过遮蔽验证解的部分内容并对熵不匹配的稀疏token位置进行能量空间插值，在保持模型自身测试时状态对齐的同时提供细粒度的token级监督。在Qwen3-8B上，PAINT相比强基线提升2.1点，相比GRPO提升2.9点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理训练面临核心矛盾：(1)强化学习方法（RL with verifiable rewards）虽能与模型测试时状态对齐，但奖励信号稀疏、方差高；(2)监督微调/蒸馏方法提供密集目标，但训练于固定轨迹或依赖更强的教师模型。近期提出的特权自蒸馏虽探索了折中方案，但未充分考虑"应揭示多少特权上下文"以及"在何处塑造学生分布"的问题。
AI.method: PAINT的核心设计：(1)基于rollout-reference重叠度对验证解进行遮蔽，保留与学生模型自身推理一致的片段；(2)在稀疏的熵不匹配token位置上执行小幅度能量空间插值，实现特权上下文与学生分布的自适应融合。该方法在三类Qwen3规模模型上均验证有效。
AI.result: 在竞赛级数学基准测试中，PAINT在Qwen3全部三个规模上均一致超越强基线。Qwen3-8B上：相比先前最优的自蒸馏基线提升2.1点（macro Avg@12），相比GRPO提升2.9点。
AI.conclusion: PAINT通过"情境重评分"视角有效调和了稀疏信用分配与密集token监督之间的张力，验证了在适当位置引入适度插值可显著提升推理能力，为自蒸馏方法的微调策略设计提供了新范式。

title: Theory-Grounded Evaluation Exposes the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
summary: Stylistic personalization - making LLMs write in a specific individual's style, rather than merely adapting to task preferences - lacks evaluation grounded in authorship science. We show that grounding evaluation in authorship verification theory transforms what benchmarks can measure. Drawing on three measurement traditions - LUAR, a trained authorship verification model; an LLM-as-judge with decoupled trait matching; and classical function-word stylometrics - we evaluate four inference-time personalization methods across 50 authors and 1,000 generations. The theory-grounded metric, LUAR, provides what ad hoc alternatives cannot: calibrated baselines, with a human ceiling of 0.756 and a cross-author floor of 0.626, that give scores absolute meaning. All methods score below this floor, from 0.484 to 0.508, exposing an authorship gap invisible to uncalibrated metrics. The three metrics produce near-zero pairwise correlations, with absolute r less than 0.07, confirming that without theoretical grounding, metric choice determines conclusions: an LLM judge declares a clear winner while LUAR finds no meaningful differentiation. These findings demonstrate the theory-benchmark cycle in action: authorship theory exposes evaluation failures that ad hoc benchmarks miss.

AI.tldr: 本文证明将作者身份验证理论引入LLM风格个性化评估可带来本质性改变：理论支撑的LUAR模型提供了校准基线（人类天花板0.756，跨作者基线0.626），暴露了当前方法均低于基线（0.484-0.508）的"作者身份差距"；而无理论支撑的指标间相关性接近零（|r|<0.07），结论完全取决于指标选择，展示了理论-基准循环的价值。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM风格个性化评估缺乏作者身份科学（authorship science）的理论支撑。现有基准无法提供有意义的绝对参考点，导致评估结论严重依赖指标选择，不同指标可能得出相互矛盾的结论。
AI.method: 实验评估了四种推理时个性化方法，涉及50位作者和1000次生成。采用三种评估传统：LUAR（训练的作者身份验证模型）、具有解耦特质匹配的LLM评判器、以及经典功能词 stylometrics。三种指标进行成对相关性分析以检验结论的一致性。
AI.result: 基于理论的标准LUAR提供了人类上限（0.756）和跨作者下限（0.626）的校准基准；所有评估方法的得分均低于下限（0.484-0.508），揭示了传统指标无法捕捉的"作者身份差距"。三种评估指标的成对相关性接近零（|r|<0.07），LLM评判器宣城有明确优胜者，而LUAR显示各方法无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，不同学科理论支撑的评估指标会产生截然不同的结论：LLM评判器宣城有明确的优胜者，而基于作者验证理论的LUAR则显示各方法之间无显著差异。这揭示了"理论-基准循环"的价值——作者身份理论能够暴露临时基准无法发现的评估缺陷。现有风格个性化方法与真实人类作者之间存在明显差距，但无理论支撑的指标无法揭示这一差距。

title: PiGGO: Physics-Guided Learnable Graph Kalman Filters for Virtual Sensing of Nonlinear Dynamic Structures under Uncertainty
summary: Digital twins provide a powerful paradigm for diagnostic and prognostic tasks in the monitoring and control of engineered systems; however, their deployment for complex structures remains challenged by model-form uncertainty, arising from unknown nonlinear dynamics, and by sparse sensing. These limitations hinder reliable online state estimation using either purely physics-based or purely data-driven approaches. This work introduces the Physics-Guided Graph Neural ODE (PiGGO) framework, a physics-informed, graph-based Bayesian state estimation approach in which a learned graph neural ordinary differential equation (GNODE) serves as the continuous-time state-transition model within an extended Kalman filter. The graph representation explicitly defines the system state-space, while physics-guided inductive biases encode known structural relationships and constrain the learning of nonlinear dynamics. By integrating graph-native learned dynamics with recursive Bayesian filtering, the proposed PiGGO framework enables online virtual sensing and uncertainty-aware state estimation for nonlinear systems with unknown model form, while maintaining generalisation across topologically similar structures. Numerical case studies demonstrate improved robustness to model uncertainty and measurement noise, outperforming both open-loop graph neural models and conventional filtering approaches in online prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理引导图神经ODE（PiGGO）框架：将受结构力学归纳偏置约束的图神经常微分方程（GNODE）作为扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的连续时间状态转移模型，实现非线性结构在稀疏传感与模型形式不确定性下的在线虚拟测量与不确定度量化。数值算例表明该方法在跨拓扑相似结构的外推中显著优于纯数据驱动/开环GNN与常规滤波方法。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生用于工程结构健康监测（SHM）中的诊断与预后，其核心能力是"虚拟测量"（virtual sensing）——由稀疏观测推断未测位置的位移、速度等响应。但实际部署面临两大瓶颈：①模型形式不确定性（model-form uncertainty），即真实结构存在材料非线性、间隙/离散反馈等未知动力学，纯物理模型难以准确描述，而纯数据驱动模型在稀疏测量下泛化性差；②在线应用中误差累积与结构个体间自然变异性，使离线训练的生成式模型在推广到同类结构时性能退化。已有物理信息机器学习（PIML）多限于离线设定且假设预设物理足够；图卡尔曼滤波虽能抑制误差累积，但标准EKF要求已知且可微的转移与观测函数，对复杂非线性系统难以满足；已有图卡尔曼滤波工作多针对低维隐变量或交通预测，缺少面向高维结构动力学的可学习图转移模型。此外，纯PIML依赖人工调参的观测损失与物理损失权重，而结构动力学本身存在天然的力平衡约束可用于构建物理一致的目标函数。
AI.method: 框架分"离线训练"与"在线滤波"两阶段解耦耦合。(1) 图表示与状态空间定义：以节点=结构节点、边=弹簧-阻尼/桁架连接的图显式定义状态空间；节点特征为静止位置p0、外力f、等效质量m，边缘特征为连接伸长ε、伸长率ε̇、当前/静止杆角θ与φ的cos/sin（避免±π/2处的不连续并保证参考坐标系等变性）、刚度k、阻尼c；边界条件通过自环边编码。几何非线性通过共旋（corotational）运动学实时更新。(2) 物理引导GNODE：状态演化函数由已知物理图卷积C_phy（线性恢复力 ξ_lin = Σ(kε+cε̇)·n̂，即"物理式消息聚合"）与黑盒神经网络图卷积C_bb（LeakyReLU MLP 消息函数，LeakyReLU 编码节点/边缘隐变量，求和聚合并乘当前边方向 n̂，隐含"非线性以保守力形式作用于节点"的归纳偏置）之和构成，状态演化为 ż_i = [u̇_i; m_i^{-1}(−ξ_lin − ξ_nonlin)] + [0; f_i]；采用 Velocity Verlet 等可微 ODE 积分器实现时间积分，观测函数为图读出算子。(3) 物理损失：以力平衡残差 r_i = m_i ü_i* + ξ_i(Z̃) − f_i* 构造 L_phy，训练时仅用该物理损失（可避免观测损失权重调参；若以预测加速度替代观测加速度则形成同义反复）。(4) 可学习图EKF：将预训练GNODE嵌入图卡尔曼滤波，以自动微分获取状态转移Jacobian A 与观测Jacobian H，执行预测/更新递推；协方差由后验Σ_{t|t}提取，观测方差 Σ_o = HΣHᵀ + R，输出 μ±2σ 的95%置信区间。进一步将物理损失改造为基于残差零均值高斯假设的负对数似然 L_phy = −Σ log p(F*,Ü*|Z̃;Θ)，残差方差 σ_{r,i}² = m_i²σ_ü,i² + σ_f,i²（假定可先验估计，可纳入可学习参数）。整体采用"先离线场景特定训练、后在线滤波纠偏"的解耦策略，以避免端到端图神经-EKF的高昂训练成本。算例包含两个非线性体系：Sobol序列布点+Delaunay三角化的随机桁架阵列（每边线性+阻尼+三次刚度 κε³）以及带角度间隙非线性的桥式桁架（含支撑中柱）；模型形式不确定性由参数按均值±5%标准差抽样（95%容差±10%）引入，非线性参数对模型未知，边共享同一消息函数相当于对非线性做平均场近似；测量噪声为高斯白噪声，SNR=25；观测稀疏通过每 n_m 个节点设置一个未测节点实现。评价指标为归一化均方误差NMSE。
AI.result: 离线阶段：PG-GNODE在训练体系上对未测节点的加速度与速度恢复良好，与真值吻合，位移存在积分漂移导致的常数偏差（进化式训练+基于积分观测的常见现象）；逐节点NMSE显示误差与拓扑、边界条件、激励位置均无明显相关性。桥式桁架因整体刚度更高，位移误差明显小于随机阵列。在线阶段（更大体系、更长时间窗、参数随机化）：纯GNODE开环预测明显退化，出现显著相位漂移与幅值偏差（因模型形式假定全结构非线性参数一致），且误差在图上呈非确定性的"聚簇"分布；GEKF方案误差大幅下降，例如32节点随机阵列位移NMSE由24.538降至0.298、速度由2.644降至0.016、加速度由2.730降至0.016，16m桥位移由30.199降至0.758，8m桥由0.088降至0.051。GEKF仍保留位移常数偏差这一积分类方法的固有特征，但后验协方差给出的95%置信区间能包络真实响应，且不确定性由预测与实测比较直接估计，因而同时涵盖模型形式误差与测量噪声（相较之下GNODE的不确定度由不含模型误差的公式给出，反而偏大/不匹配）。逐节点误差聚簇现象亦有所减轻。分析表明滤波机制本身即证明了模型形式（同一非线性形式与标称参数）在同类结构间的可泛化性；残余误差源于非线性离散/非光滑性不满足EKF的高斯误差假设。
AI.conclusion: PiGGO将物理引导的图神经ODE与扩展卡尔曼滤波统一于图表示框架，实现了对非线性结构体系中模型形式不确定性、稀疏观测与测量噪声的在线、含不确定度的状态估计，具备跨拓扑相似结构的泛化能力，在泛化性与鲁棒性上优于纯数据驱动/开环图神经模型与常规滤波方法。主要局限与未来工作：①离线训练需已知初始状态，对无静止初态的在役结构群需训练长时窗的"图神经-EKF"一体化模型，训练成本高；②EKF的高斯误差假设难以处理离散/非光滑的非线性误差，可考虑无迹卡尔曼滤波或粒子滤波等非高斯滤波方案；③假设非线性存在于整个结构且形式一致，未来需引入分层GNN"开关"模型实现局部非线性存在性/形式的在线估计，或采用Alippi & Zambon式把邻接矩阵作为演化的隐变量以刻画时变非线性连接；④未来还将拓展局部化/非光滑非线性、适应性图表示与滤波过程端到端联合学习。代码与数据已开源于 GitHub（struct-pggnode）。

title: StarDrinks: An English and Korean Test Set for SLU Evaluation in a Drink Ordering Scenario
summary: LLMs and speech assistants are increasingly used for task-oriented interactions, yet their evaluation often relies on controlled scenarios that fail to capture the variability and complexity of real user requests. Drink ordering, for example, involves diverse named entities, drink types, sizes, customizations, and brand-specific terminology, as well as spontaneous speech phenomena such as hesitations and self-corrections. To address this gap, we introduce StarDrinks, a test set in English and Korean containing speech utterances features, transcriptions, and annotated slots. Our dataset supports speech-to-slots SLU, transcription-to-slots NLU, and speech-to-transcription ASR evaluation, providing a realistic benchmark for model robustness and generalization in a linguistically rich, real-world task.

AI.tldr: StarDrinks addresses the gap between controlled and real-world SLU evaluation by providing a bilingual (English/Korean) dataset for drink ordering that captures authentic speech phenomena, enabling comprehensive robustness testing of speech assistants.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM/speech assistant evaluation relies on controlled scenarios that inadequately represent real-world complexity. Drink ordering presents realistic challenges: diverse named entities, spontaneous speech phenomena (hesitations, self-corrections), and linguistically varied terminology.
AI.method: StarDrinks dataset construction: collecting speech utterances with transcriptions, annotating slots (drink types, sizes, customizations, brand-specific terminology), supporting three evaluation task formats.
AI.result: StarDrinks offers a linguistically rich, real-world testbed for evaluating model robustness and generalization across speech-to-slots, transcription-to-slots, and ASR tasks.
AI.conclusion: StarDrinks provides a multilingual (English/Korean) benchmark supporting three evaluation tracks (ASR, NLU, SLU), enabling assessment of model robustness in realistic drink ordering scenarios with authentic speech phenomena.

title: Who Trains Matters: Federated Learning under Enrollment and Participation Selection Biases
summary: Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model from updates contributed by distributed clients, often implicitly assuming that contributing clients are representative of the target population. In practice, this representativeness assumption can fail at two distinct stages, inducing selection bias. First, eligibility rules such as device constraints, software requirements, or user consent determine which clients are ever enrolled and reachable for training, inducing \emph{enrollment bias}. Second, among enrolled clients, user and system factors such as battery state, network status, and local time determine which clients participate in each communication round, inducing \emph{participation bias}. Although existing work has largely addressed round-level participation bias, it has paid far less attention to population-level enrollment bias, which can induce a persistent mismatch between the training objective and the target-population objective. We formalize FL under a two-stage selection model and derive \textsc{FedIPW}, an inverse-probability-weighted aggregation scheme that recovers the target-population mean update under standard ignorability and positivity assumptions. Because client-level covariates are often unavailable for non-enrolled clients, we also introduce a limited-information aggregate-calibration extension that uses known target-population summaries to reweight the enrolled sample, partially correcting enrollment bias. We further provide an algorithm-agnostic optimization analysis under residual weighting error and show that incomplete selection correction can induce a non-vanishing bias floor. Finally, experiments on synthetic federated logistic regression validate the predicted objective mismatch and show that enrollment correction reduces target-population error under two-stage selection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中两类选择偏差（入组偏差和参与偏差）提出FedIPW逆概率加权聚合方案，在标准假设下恢复目标人群均值更新，并提出有限信息校准扩展部分纠正入组偏差。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习隐含假设贡献客户端代表目标人群，但实际中存在两类选择偏差：入组偏差（ eligibility 规则筛选）和参与偏差（每轮参与受用户/系统因素影响）。现有工作主要解决轮级参与偏差，忽视人群级入组偏差，导致训练目标与目标人群目标之间存在持续不匹配。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段选择模型形式化；FedIPW逆概率加权聚合方案（在标准可忽略性和 positivity 假设下恢复目标人群均值更新）；有限信息聚合校准扩展（利用已知目标人群汇总统计量重新加权）；算法无关的残差加权误差优化分析。
AI.result: FedIPW在两阶段选择下可恢复目标人群均值更新；有限信息校准可部分纠正入组偏差；不完整校正导致非消失偏差底界；合成联邦逻辑回归实验验证了入组校正可减少目标人群误差。
AI.conclusion: FedIPW可恢复目标人群均值更新，且在标准假设下可消除参与偏差；有限信息校准扩展可部分纠正入组偏差；不完整的-selection correction可能导致非零偏差下界。实验验证了入组校正可减少目标人群误差。

title: Tree-of-Text: A Tree-based Prompting Framework for Table-to-Text Generation in the Sports Domain
comment: Accepted by ACL SRW 2025: Long Paper (Oral)
summary: Generating sports game reports from structured tables is a complex table-to-text task that demands both precise data interpretation and fluent narrative generation. Traditional model-based approaches require large, annotated datasets, while prompt-based methods using large language models (LLMs) often struggle with hallucination due to weak table comprehension. To overcome these challenges, we propose Tree-of-Text, a tree-structured prompting framework that guides LLMs through a three-stage generation process: (1) Content Planning, where relevant operations and arguments are selected from the input tables; (2) Operation Execution, which breaks down large tables into manageable sub-tables; and (3) Content Generation, where short textual outputs are merged and rewritten into a cohesive report. Experiments show that our method outperforms existing methods on ShuttleSet+, leads in RG and CO metrics on RotoWire-FG, and excels in CS and CO on MLB with roughly 40% of the time and cost of Chain-of-Table. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of Tree-of-Text and suggest a promising direction for prompt-based table-to-text generation in the sports domain.

AI.tldr: Tree-of-Text是一种用于从结构化表格生成体育赛事报告的树状提示框架，通过内容规划、操作执行和内容生成三阶段流程解决大语言模型的表格理解和幻觉问题，在多个数据集上表现优异且效率更高。
AI.motivation: 传统基于模型的表格到文本方法需要大量标注数据集，而基于大语言模型(LLM)的提示方法由于表格理解能力弱，容易产生幻觉问题，导致生成质量不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Tree-of-Text树状提示框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 内容规划阶段从输入表格中选择相关操作和参数；(2) 操作执行阶段将大表格分解为可管理的子表；(3) 内容生成阶段将短文本输出合并重写为连贯报告。
AI.result: 在ShuttleSet+上优于现有方法；在RotoWire-FG的RG和CO指标上领先；在MLB的CS和CO上表现优异；且时间和成本仅为Chain-of-Table的约40%。
AI.conclusion: Tree-of-Text方法有效且高效，为体育领域基于提示的表格到文本生成提供了有前景的研究方向。

title: Electricity price forecasting across Norway's five bidding zones in the post-crisis era
summary: Norway's electricity market is heavily dominated by hydropower, but the 2021--2022 energy crisis and stronger integration with Continental Europe have fundamentally altered price formation, reducing the reliability of forecasting models calibrated on historical data. Despite the critical need for updated models, a unified benchmark evaluating feature contributions across all structurally diverse Norwegian bidding zones remains lacking. Here we present a comprehensive evaluation of electricity price forecasting across all five Norwegian Nord Pool bidding zones. We constructed a multimodal hourly dataset spanning 2019--2025 and evaluated eight forecasting model families including LightGBM, ARX, and advanced deep learning architectures using a strictly causal test set. We implemented robust rolling-origin backtesting, leave-one-group-out feature ablation, and conditional regime analysis to dissect model performance and feature utility. Our results show that LightGBM achieves the best performance in every zone with MAE ranging from 1.64 to 5.74~EUR/MWh, while the ridge ARX model remains a highly competitive linear benchmark in northern zones. Feature ablation reveals that models relying solely on lagged prices and calendar variables achieve high accuracy and often match or exceed full multimodal integration. However, conditional regime analysis demonstrates that external features like reservoir levels and gas prices remain crucial to stratify forecast errors, which consistently increase under stressed market regimes. This highlights the practical value of model interpretability and regime awareness for decision makers facing structural changes in market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对挪威五个电力竞价区，构建了2019-2025年的多模态小时级数据集，系统评估了LightGBM、ARX及深度学习等八类预测模型家族的表现。研究表明LightGBM在所有区域均取得最佳性能（MAE为1.64-5.74 EUR/MWh），但仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的简约模型同样表现优异，而水库蓄水位和天然气价格等外部特征在压力市场状态下对分层预测误差至关重要。
AI.motivation: 2021-2022年欧洲能源危机和挪威与欧洲大陆电力市场整合加深，导致基于历史数据校准的预测模型可靠性下降，而现有研究缺乏针对挪威全部五个竞价区的统一基准评估框架。
AI.method: 构建2019-2025年多模态小时级数据集；采用严格的事后因果测试集划分；实施滚动原点回测（rolling-origin backtesting）、留一组特征消融（leave-one-group-out feature ablation）及条件机制分析（conditional regime analysis）；评估八类预测模型家族。
AI.result: LightGBM在所有五个竞价区均取得最优性能，MAE范围为1.64-5.74 EUR/MWh；岭回归ARX模型在北部区域是具有高度竞争力的线性基准。仅使用滞后价格和日历变量的模型已能达到高精度，常匹配或超越全模态融合模型。然而，压力市场机制下外部特征（如水库蓄水位、天然气价格）对预测误差分层仍有关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 模型可解释性和机制感知对应对市场结构性变化具有实践价值；特征简约性在高精度预测中可行，但外部特征在压力市场下不可或缺。

title: SafeReview: Defending LLM-based Review Systems Against Adversarial Hidden Prompts
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into academic peer review, their vulnerability to adversarial prompts -- adversarial instructions embedded in submissions to manipulate outcomes -- emerges as a critical threat to scholarly integrity. To counter this, we propose a novel adversarial framework where a Generator model, trained to create sophisticated attack prompts, is jointly optimized with a Defender model tasked with their detection. This system is trained using a loss function inspired by Information Retrieval Generative Adversarial Networks, which fosters a dynamic co-evolution between the two models, forcing the Defender to develop robust capabilities against continuously improving attack strategies. The resulting framework demonstrates significantly enhanced resilience to novel and evolving threats compared to static defenses, thereby establishing a critical foundation for securing the integrity of peer review.

AI.tldr: SafeReview 提出一个"攻防协同进化"的对抗训练框架：攻击方（Generator，Qwen3-4B-Instruct）用 GRPO 学习生成隐蔽的指令式注入提示以操纵 LLM 审稿评分，防守方（Defender，DeepReviewer-14B）用 DPO 学习在注入下仍给出与干净稿一致的评审；两者以最小—最大博弈交替更新（T=3 轮）。在 DeepReview-13k 测试集上，SafeReview 在三种攻击者（Qwen3-4B/8B、Llama-3.2-3B）下均取得最高 Spearman（0.392–0.409）、更低 FPR，且在良性输入上不退化（Spearman 0.365→0.391，FNR 45.9%→36.7%），优于静态 DPO、系统提示防御、SecAlign 与 PromptGuard。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被广泛用于学术同行评审（DeepReview、ICLR 2025 workshop、AAAI 2025 等），但"对抗性隐藏提示"——即作者在投稿中隐蔽嵌入指令以操纵评审结果——构成对学术诚信的实质威胁：实测平均评分从 5.72 被抬升至 7.33，Gemini-2.0-Flash-Thinking 单次被抬升 +4.26 分，足以让本应拒稿的论文进入接收区。现有方案存在三重不足：(1) 基于已知攻击训练的静态防御无法应对不断演化的攻击；(2) 主流防御（多层过滤、指令层级、SecAlign、困惑度过滤）要么静态、要么面向短文本，难以在长篇论文（约 10K token）中定位局部恶意指令；(3) 已有协同进化工作（Liu et al., 2025）仅在短文本评分上做文本梯度优化，并未在长文科学文档上做模型权重层面的攻防共演化。此外，长文上下文定位难、RL 对大模型训练不稳定、攻击形态多样难覆盖，构成了方法设计的三项挑战。
AI.method: 形式化：论文 p 经注入 τ=A_θ(p) 得到 p⊕τ，攻击成功以分数提升量 Δs=s_adv−s_orig 度量，目标是训练稳健评审器使 R*(p)≈R*(p⊕τ)。算法（Algorithm 1）为 T=3 轮的协同进化最小—最大博弈，每轮两阶段：Phase 1 攻击演化——攻击者用 GRPO 训练，组大小 G=8，奖励为离散分数增量，优势按组内标准化，重要性比 ρ 与逐 token 无偏 KL 估计器给出稳定梯度信号，KL 参考模型在每轮重置为上一轮 checkpoint（滚动参考），并以攻击向量分类法为条件生成多样化攻击（8–12 条指令式句子）；Phase 2 防守强化——用本轮更新后的攻击者重新生成注入（而非沿用 GRPO 中间 rollout），由当前防守者分别生成干净稿评审 y+（偏好）与受攻击稿评审 y−（拒绝），输入统一为被注入的论文，用 DPO 损失 L=-E[log σ(Δr_θ)] 更新防守者，参考策略 π_ref=上一轮防守者。针对长文：注入随机插入 Abstract/Introduction/Methodology/Experiments/Conclusion 各标准章节，使防守者学会位置无关的检测。实现细节：训练集为 500 篇去标识的 NeurIPS 2024 论文（录用/拒稿 1:1），测试集为 1,286 篇 ICLR 2024 论文（DeepReview-13k），存在会议分布偏移；8×H100 80G（GRPO 阶段 4 卡训练攻击者、4 卡用 vLLM 部署 DeepReviewer-14B 作在线奖励模型；DPO 阶段全 8 卡，DeepSpeed ZeRO-3，30 步/轮）。评测用 Spearman、平均评分、Accuracy、FPR、FNR，阈值相关指标按预测分数 top-33% 分位标定以匹配真实录用率。基线：无防御 DeepReview、Static DPO（一次性攻击检查点训练）、System Defense（系统提示加固）、PromptGuard 2（512 token 分块+滑窗检测+拒检即拒稿）、SecAlign。
